title: Garlic Butter Shrimp Sizzle
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_001","title":"Garlic Butter Shrimp Sizzle","calories":"300-400","cuisine":"Spanish","difficulty":"Easy","description":"Succulent shrimp sautéed in garlic butter and finished with a splash of lemon for a zesty delight.","servings":1,"prep_minutes":5,"cook_minutes":10,"ingredients":[{"name":"shrimp","quantity":"150","unit":"g"},{"name":"garlic","quantity":"2","unit":"cloves"},{"name":"butter","quantity":"30","unit":"g"},{"name":"lemon","quantity":"1","unit":"slice"}],"spices":[{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt","pink salt","table salt"]},{"name":"black pepper","alternatives":["white pepper","lemon pepper","crushed red pepper"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Start by peeling and deveining 150g of shrimp if not already prepared.","Mince 2 cloves of garlic finely and set aside.","In a skillet, melt 30g of butter over medium heat (around 180°C) until bubbly.","Add the minced garlic to the skillet and sauté for about 1 minute until fragrant, stirring frequently to avoid burning.","Increase the heat to high and add the shrimp to the skillet. Cook for 2-3 minutes on one side until they start to turn pink.","Flip the shrimp over, season with a pinch of salt and black pepper, and cook for another 1-2 minutes until fully opaque.","Remove the skillet from heat, squeeze a slice of fresh lemon juice over the shrimp, and toss to coat.","Serve immediately, garnished with the lemon slice on the side."]}

title: Citrus Garlic Shrimp Delight
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_002","title":"Citrus Garlic Shrimp Delight","calories":"300-400","cuisine":"Spanish","difficulty":"Medium","description":"A vibrant dish showcasing shrimp in a citrus garlic butter sauce, perfect for a quick meal.","servings":1,"prep_minutes":5,"cook_minutes":12,"ingredients":[{"name":"shrimp","quantity":"150","unit":"g"},{"name":"garlic","quantity":"2","unit":"cloves"},{"name":"butter","quantity":"25","unit":"g"},{"name":"lemon","quantity":"1","unit":"slice"}],"spices":[{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt","smoked salt","kosher salt"]},{"name":"paprika","alternatives":["smoked paprika","cayenne pepper","chili powder"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Prepare the shrimp by peeling and deveining 150g, then set aside.","Finely mince 2 cloves of garlic and set aside for cooking.","In a medium skillet, melt 25g of butter over medium heat (around 170°C).","Once melted, add the minced garlic and stir for about 30 seconds until fragrant, stirring to avoid browning.","Increase the heat to high, and add the shrimp, cooking for about 3 minutes until they turn pink.","Season with a pinch of salt and paprika, mix well, and then add a squeeze of fresh lemon juice.","Cook for an additional minute until shrimp are cooked through and coated in the sauce.","Serve hot on a plate with the lemon slice arranged attractively."]}

title: Lemon Garlic Shrimp Pasta
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_003","title":"Lemon Garlic Shrimp Pasta","calories":"300-400","cuisine":"Spanish","difficulty":"Medium","description":"A delicious pasta dish featuring shrimp in a rich garlic butter and lemon sauce, ready in no time.","servings":1,"prep_minutes":5,"cook_minutes":15,"ingredients":[{"name":"shrimp","quantity":"150","unit":"g"},{"name":"garlic","quantity":"2","unit":"cloves"},{"name":"butter","quantity":"20","unit":"g"},{"name":"lemon","quantity":"1","unit":"slice"},{"name":"pasta","quantity":"80","unit":"g"}],"spices":[{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt","rock salt","flaky salt"]},{"name":"black pepper","alternatives":["white pepper","cayenne pepper","mixed peppercorns"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Cook 80g of pasta in salted boiling water according to package instructions until al dente.","While the pasta cooks, prepare 150g of shrimp by peeling and deveining them.","Mince 2 cloves of garlic and set aside.","In a large skillet, melt 20g of butter over medium heat (about 180°C).","Add minced garlic to the skillet and sauté for about 1 minute until aromatic and lightly golden.","Add the shrimp to the skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes, flipping halfway, until they are pink and opaque.","Drain the pasta and add it to the skillet with shrimp, mixing everything well.","Squeeze a slice of lemon juice over the pasta and shrimp, season with salt and black pepper, and toss to combine before serving."]}

title: Shrimp and Lemon Tapas
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_004","title":"Shrimp and Lemon Tapas","calories":"300-400","cuisine":"Spanish","difficulty":"Easy","description":"A quick and easy shrimp tapas dish infused with garlic and zesty lemon—perfect for sharing.","servings":1,"prep_minutes":5,"cook_minutes":8,"ingredients":[{"name":"shrimp","quantity":"150","unit":"g"},{"name":"garlic","quantity":"1","unit":"clove"},{"name":"butter","quantity":"15","unit":"g"},{"name":"lemon","quantity":"1","unit":"slice"}],"spices":[{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt","table salt","black salt"]},{"name":"cayenne pepper","alternatives":["smoked paprika","black pepper","red pepper flakes"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Start by thawing and peeling 150g of shrimp if necessary.","Crush 1 clove of garlic and set aside.","In a small skillet, melt 15g of butter over medium heat (approximately 170°C).","Add the crushed garlic and sauté for about 1 minute until fragrant and slightly golden.","Increase the heat to high, add the shrimp, and cook for about 3-4 minutes, turning occasionally until they turn pink.","Season with a pinch of salt and cayenne pepper, stirring well to coat.","Remove the skillet from heat and add a squeeze of lemon juice over the shrimp.","Serve immediately on a small plate or on toothpicks as delightful tapas."]}

title: Garlic Butter Shrimp Bowl
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_005","title":"Garlic Butter Shrimp Bowl","calories":"300-400","cuisine":"Spanish","difficulty":"Easy","description":"A comforting shrimp bowl filled with garlic butter flavor and a touch of lemon zest for freshness.","servings":1,"prep_minutes":5,"cook_minutes":10,"ingredients":[{"name":"shrimp","quantity":"150","unit":"g"},{"name":"garlic","quantity":"1","unit":"clove"},{"name":"butter","quantity":"25","unit":"g"},{"name":"lemon","quantity":"1","unit":"slice"}],"spices":[{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt","finishing salt","pink salt"]},{"name":"black pepper","alternatives":["white pepper","Lemon pepper","chili powder"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Peel and devein 150g of shrimp, placing them into a bowl.","Mince 1 clove of garlic finely and set aside for cooking.","Melt 25g of butter in a skillet over medium heat (around 175°C).","Add the minced garlic and sauté for about 1 minute, stirring frequently until fragrant.","Increase heat to high, add the shrimp to the skillet, and cook for 3-4 minutes, turning occasionally until they are pink.","Season with a pinch of salt and black pepper and stir well to combine.","Remove from the heat, add a squeeze of lemon juice, and give it a final stir.","Serve in a bowl, garnished with the lemon slice on top."]}

title: Indian Spiced Rice Bowl
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_006","title":"Indian Spiced Rice Bowl","calories":"300-350","cuisine":"Indian","difficulty":"Easy","description":"A flavorful rice bowl with spiced onions and a fried egg, perfect for a quick meal.","servings":1,"prep_minutes":5,"cook_minutes":15,"ingredients":[{"name":"rice","quantity":"75","unit":"g"},{"name":"egg","quantity":"1","unit":"unit"},{"name":"soy sauce","quantity":"15","unit":"ml"},{"name":"onion","quantity":"50","unit":"g"}],"spices":[{"name":"turmeric","alternatives":["cumin","coriander"]},{"name":"cayenne pepper","alternatives":["paprika","chili powder"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Rinse 75g of rice in cold water until the water runs clear to remove excess starch, then soak for 10 minutes.","In a small pot, bring 150ml of water to a boil, add the soaked rice, cover, and reduce heat to low. Cook for 10-12 minutes until water is absorbed.","While the rice is cooking, finely chop 50g of onion. Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a skillet over medium heat.","Add the chopped onion to the skillet and sauté for 3-4 minutes until they are translucent and slightly browned.","Add 1 teaspoon of turmeric and ½ teaspoon of cayenne pepper to the onions, stir for another minute until fragrant.","Fry 1 egg in the same skillet, sunny side up or to your preference, for about 2-3 minutes.","Once the rice is cooked, fluff it with a fork, mix in the sautéed onions and drizzle 15ml of soy sauce over the top.","Serve the rice mixture in a bowl topped with the fried egg and enjoy your meal!"]}

title: Soy Sauce and Egg Rice Casserole
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_007","title":"Soy Sauce and Egg Rice Casserole","calories":"320-370","cuisine":"Indian","difficulty":"Medium","description":"A comforting casserole-style dish with rice, soy sauce, and baked egg.","servings":1,"prep_minutes":10,"cook_minutes":25,"ingredients":[{"name":"rice","quantity":"75","unit":"g"},{"name":"egg","quantity":"1","unit":"unit"},{"name":"soy sauce","quantity":"20","unit":"ml"},{"name":"onion","quantity":"50","unit":"g"}],"spices":[{"name":"garam masala","alternatives":["curry powder","fenugreek"]},{"name":"black pepper","alternatives":["white pepper","green peppercorn"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Preheat your oven to 180°C (350°F). Rinse 75g of rice until the water is clear.","In a small saucepan, combine rinsed rice with 150ml of water. Bring to a boil, then cover and simmer on low for 12 minutes until cooked.","While the rice cooks, finely chop 50g of onion. In a skillet, sauté the onion in 1 tablespoon of oil over medium heat until soft, about 5-7 minutes.","In a bowl, combine the cooked rice, sautéed onions, 20ml of soy sauce, and ½ teaspoon of garam masala. Mix well.","Transfer the rice mixture into a small baking dish. Create a small well in the center and crack 1 egg into the well.","Bake in the preheated oven for 15 minutes or until the egg is set and the edges of the rice are slightly crisp.","Once done, sprinkle with black pepper and serve your casserole warm.","Enjoy your delicious and comforting rice casserole!"]}

title: Fried Rice with Egg and Onions
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_008","title":"Fried Rice with Egg and Onions","calories":"350-400","cuisine":"Indian","difficulty":"Easy","description":"A quick stir-fried dish featuring rice, egg, and onions with a touch of soy sauce.","servings":1,"prep_minutes":5,"cook_minutes":15,"ingredients":[{"name":"rice","quantity":"75","unit":"g"},{"name":"egg","quantity":"1","unit":"unit"},{"name":"soy sauce","quantity":"15","unit":"ml"},{"name":"onion","quantity":"50","unit":"g"}],"spices":[{"name":"cumin","alternatives":["coriander","fennel"]},{"name":"chili flakes","alternatives":["paprika","cayenne pepper"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Begin by cooking 75g of rice as per package instructions and let it cool completely to prevent mushiness.","Finely chop 50g of onion. Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.","Add the chopped onion to the skillet and fry for 2-3 minutes until they become translucent.","Push the onions to the side of the skillet and crack 1 egg into the pan. Scramble it quickly for about 1-2 minutes until fully cooked.","Add the cooled rice to the skillet, combine it with the onions and egg, and stir-fry for about 3-4 minutes, ensuring the rice is heated through.","Drizzle 15ml of soy sauce over the rice mixture and sprinkle ½ teaspoon of cumin and a pinch of chili flakes. Stir for an additional 2 minutes.","Make sure the rice is well-coated with soy sauce and heated properly before serving.","Enjoy your homemade fried rice with a burst of flavors!"]}

title: Onion Egg Rice Scramble
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_009","title":"Onion Egg Rice Scramble","calories":"310-360","cuisine":"Indian","difficulty":"Easy","description":"A delightful scramble of rice, egg, and sautéed onions, perfect for any meal.","servings":1,"prep_minutes":5,"cook_minutes":15,"ingredients":[{"name":"rice","quantity":"75","unit":"g"},{"name":"egg","quantity":"1","unit":"unit"},{"name":"soy sauce","quantity":"15","unit":"ml"},{"name":"onion","quantity":"50","unit":"g"}],"spices":[{"name":"mint","alternatives":["coriander","basil"]},{"name":"cinnamon","alternatives":["nutmeg","cloves"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["In a pot, boil 150ml of water and cook 75g of rice for 10-12 minutes until tender. Drain and set aside to cool.","While the rice is cooking, finely chop 50g of onion. In a frying pan, heat 1 tablespoon of oil over medium heat.","Add the chopped onion and cook for about 5 minutes until golden and soft.","In a bowl, beat 1 egg with a pinch of salt and pepper, then pour it into the pan with the onions, stirring carefully.","Once the egg begins to set, add the cooked rice to the pan, breaking it up gently and combining thoroughly with the onions and egg.","Drizzle 15ml of soy sauce over the mixture, and add ½ teaspoon of mint and a dash of cinnamon, mixing well to incorporate.","Continue cooking for another 2-3 minutes until everything is heated through and slightly crispy.","Serve immediately and enjoy your onion egg rice scramble!"]}

title: Egg and Onion Rice Pilaf
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_010","title":"Egg and Onion Rice Pilaf","calories":"330-380","cuisine":"Indian","difficulty":"Medium","description":"A comforting pilaf made with seasoned rice, egg, and onions sautéed to perfection.","servings":1,"prep_minutes":5,"cook_minutes":20,"ingredients":[{"name":"rice","quantity":"75","unit":"g"},{"name":"egg","quantity":"1","unit":"unit"},{"name":"soy sauce","quantity":"15","unit":"ml"},{"name":"onion","quantity":"50","unit":"g"}],"spices":[{"name":"cardamom","alternatives":["clove","star anise"]},{"name":"peppercorns","alternatives":["black mustard seeds","cumin seeds"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Rinse 75g of rice in cold water for about 2 minutes. Drain and set it aside.","In a medium saucepan, add the rinsed rice and 150ml of water, bring it to a boil, cover, and reduce to simmer for 12 minutes.","While the rice cooks, finely chop 50g of onion and heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a frying pan over medium heat.","Sauté the onion for 5 minutes until it turns soft and light golden, then add 2-3 crushed cardamom pods and a pinch of salt.","Stir for another minute until fragrant, then push the onions to one side of the pan and crack in 1 egg, cooking it to your preferred doneness.","Once the rice is cooked, fluff it with a fork and add it to the onion and egg mixture in the pan. Stir well to combine.","Add 15ml of soy sauce and a sprinkle of crushed peppercorns, mixing thoroughly for about 2-3 minutes to combine flavors.","Serve warm as a hearty pilaf dish, perfect for a quick meal!"]}

title: Greek Lemon Butter Fish
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_011","title":"Greek Lemon Butter Fish","calories":"300-400","cuisine":"Greek","difficulty":"Easy","description":"A deliciously light and zesty dish featuring fish fillets cooked to perfection with garlic and lemon.","servings":1,"prep_minutes":10,"cook_minutes":10,"ingredients":[{"name":"fish","quantity":"150","unit":"g"},{"name":"lemon","quantity":"1","unit":"whole"},{"name":"olive oil","quantity":"2","unit":"tbsp"},{"name":"garlic","quantity":"2","unit":"cloves"}],"spices":[{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt","kosher salt"]},{"name":"black pepper","alternatives":["white pepper","red pepper flakes"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Preheat your skillet over medium heat for about 2 minutes.","Add 2 tablespoons of olive oil to the skillet and let it heat for another minute, ensuring it shimmers.","Mince 2 cloves of garlic and add them to the skillet, sautéing until fragrant (about 1 minute).","Place the 150g fish fillet in the skillet and season it generously with salt and black pepper.","Cook the fish for 4-5 minutes until the bottom is golden and it easily flakes with a fork.","Flip the fish carefully and squeeze the juice of the whole lemon over it; cook for another 3-4 minutes.","Once cooked, remove the fish from the skillet and let it rest for a minute before serving with the pan sauce."]}

title: Lemon Garlic Fish Tacos
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_012","title":"Lemon Garlic Fish Tacos","calories":"300-400","cuisine":"Greek","difficulty":"Medium","description":"Zesty and bright, these fish tacos are a fantastic twist on classic flavors.","servings":1,"prep_minutes":15,"cook_minutes":10,"ingredients":[{"name":"fish","quantity":"150","unit":"g"},{"name":"lemon","quantity":"1","unit":"whole"},{"name":"olive oil","quantity":"1","unit":"tbsp"},{"name":"garlic","quantity":"1","unit":"clove"}],"spices":[{"name":"cumin","alternatives":["coriander","paprika"]},{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt","table salt"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Preheat a non-stick skillet over medium-high heat for about 2-3 minutes.","Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in the skillet until hot but not smoking.","Finely chop 1 clove of garlic and add it to the skillet, stirring for 30 seconds until fragrant.","Add the 150g fish, season with salt and 1/2 teaspoon of cumin; cook for 4-5 minutes on each side until golden.","Squeeze the juice of 1 whole lemon over the fish while it cooks, letting it infuse the flavors.","Once the fish is done, transfer it to a plate and flake it with a fork.","Serve in warmed tortillas, garnished with additional lemon juice and optional toppings."]}

title: Garlic Lemon Baked Fish
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_013","title":"Garlic Lemon Baked Fish","calories":"300-400","cuisine":"Greek","difficulty":"Easy","description":"A simple yet incredibly flavorful baked fish dish with a zesty garlic and lemon marinade.","servings":1,"prep_minutes":5,"cook_minutes":15,"ingredients":[{"name":"fish","quantity":"150","unit":"g"},{"name":"lemon","quantity":"1","unit":"whole"},{"name":"olive oil","quantity":"1","unit":"tbsp"},{"name":"garlic","quantity":"1","unit":"clove"}],"spices":[{"name":"thyme","alternatives":["oregano","basil"]},{"name":"black pepper","alternatives":["white pepper","red pepper"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Preheat the oven to 200°C (400°F) for about 10 minutes.","Grease a small baking dish with cooking spray or a bit of olive oil.","Mince 1 clove of garlic and mix it with 1 tablespoon of olive oil, juice of the lemon, and a pinch of thyme.","Place the 150g fish in the baking dish and pour the garlic-lemon mixture over it, ensuring it's well-coated.","Season with salt and black pepper to taste.","Bake in the preheated oven for 12-15 minutes until the fish is opaque and flakes easily with a fork.","Remove from the oven and allow to rest for a couple of minutes before serving."]}

title: Lemon Garlic Fish Skewers
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_014","title":"Lemon Garlic Fish Skewers","calories":"300-400","cuisine":"Greek","difficulty":"Medium","description":"Tender and juicy fish skewers marinated in a fragrant lemon-garlic mixture.","servings":1,"prep_minutes":10,"cook_minutes":10,"ingredients":[{"name":"fish","quantity":"150","unit":"g"},{"name":"lemon","quantity":"1","unit":"whole"},{"name":"olive oil","quantity":"1","unit":"tbsp"},{"name":"garlic","quantity":"1","unit":"clove"}],"spices":[{"name":"paprika","alternatives":["smoked paprika","cayenne"]},{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt","flaky salt"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Cut the fish into 2.5cm cubes and place them in a bowl.","In a separate bowl, mix 1 tablespoon of olive oil, minced 1 clove of garlic, juice of 1 lemon, and a sprinkle of paprika.","Pour the marinade over the fish and let it sit for 15 minutes.","Preheat a grill or grill pan over medium-high heat for about 5 minutes.","Thread the marinated fish onto skewers, leaving space between each piece.","Grill the skewers for 4-5 minutes on each side, brushing with remaining marinade, until slightly charred.","Remove from the grill and serve with lemon wedges on the side."]}

title: Garlic Lemon Fish Soup
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_015","title":"Garlic Lemon Fish Soup","calories":"300-400","cuisine":"Greek","difficulty":"Easy","description":"A comforting and aromatic soup made with fresh fish, garlic, and lemon.","servings":1,"prep_minutes":10,"cook_minutes":20,"ingredients":[{"name":"fish","quantity":"150","unit":"g"},{"name":"lemon","quantity":"1","unit":"whole"},{"name":"olive oil","quantity":"2","unit":"tbsp"},{"name":"garlic","quantity":"2","unit":"cloves"}],"spices":[{"name":"bay leaf","alternatives":["thyme","oregano"]},{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt","kosher salt"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["In a pot, heat 2 tablespoons of olive oil over medium heat for about 2 minutes.","Mince 2 cloves of garlic and add them to the pot; sauté for 1 minute until fragrant.","Add 2 cups of water and 1 bay leaf, bring to a simmer for 5 minutes.","Cut the 150g fish into smaller pieces and add to the pot; cook for another 7 minutes.","Squeeze the juice of 1 lemon into the soup, season with salt to taste.","Remove the bay leaf and let it cook for an additional 2 minutes.","Serve hot with lemon wedges on the side."]}

title: Avocado Tomato Salad with Lime Dressing
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_016","title":"Avocado Tomato Salad with Lime Dressing","calories":"200-300","cuisine":"Thai","difficulty":"Easy","description":"A refreshing avocado and tomato salad drizzled with a zesty lime dressing, perfect for a light meal.","servings":1,"prep_minutes":10,"cook_minutes":15,"ingredients":[{"name":"avocado","quantity":"1","unit":"whole"},{"name":"tomato","quantity":"1","unit":"whole"},{"name":"onion","quantity":"1/4","unit":"whole"},{"name":"lime","quantity":"1","unit":"whole"}],"spices":[{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt","Himalayan salt"]},{"name":"black pepper","alternatives":["white pepper","red pepper flakes"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Start by slicing the avocado in half, removing the pit, and scooping the flesh into a bowl.","Chop the tomato and add it to the bowl with the avocado.","Finely chop the onion and mix it into the bowl with the avocado and tomato.","Squeeze the juice of one lime over the salad mixture, ensuring to coat everything evenly.","Add a pinch of salt and a dash of black pepper to taste, and mix gently to combine.","Serve immediately for the freshest flavor, garnishing with a lime wedge if desired."]}

title: Spicy Avocado Tostada with Tomato Salsa
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_017","title":"Spicy Avocado Tostada with Tomato Salsa","calories":"250-350","cuisine":"Thai","difficulty":"Medium","description":"A crispy tostada topped with creamy avocado and refreshing tomato salsa, enhanced with a touch of spice.","servings":1,"prep_minutes":10,"cook_minutes":5,"ingredients":[{"name":"avocado","quantity":"1","unit":"whole"},{"name":"tomato","quantity":"1","unit":"whole"},{"name":"onion","quantity":"1/4","unit":"whole"},{"name":"lime","quantity":"1","unit":"whole"},{"name":"corn tortilla","quantity":"1","unit":"whole"}],"spices":[{"name":"cayenne pepper","alternatives":["paprika","chili powder"]},{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt","kosher salt"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Preheat a skillet over medium heat and lightly toast the corn tortilla for about 2-3 minutes on each side until crispy.","While the tortilla is toasting, dice the avocado and place it in a bowl.","Chop the tomato and onion, adding them to the bowl with the avocado.","Squeeze the juice of one lime over the mixture, adding a pinch of salt and cayenne pepper to taste.","Once the tortilla is crispy, remove it from the skillet and place it on a plate.","Top the tortilla with the avocado and tomato mixture, spreading it evenly.","Serve immediately with extra lime wedges on the side for drizzling."]}

title: Creamy Avocado Lime Dip with Tomato Salsa
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_018","title":"Creamy Avocado Lime Dip with Tomato Salsa","calories":"200-300","cuisine":"Thai","difficulty":"Easy","description":"A smooth avocado dip combined with sweet and tangy tomato salsa, perfect for dipping or as a topping.","servings":1,"prep_minutes":10,"cook_minutes":15,"ingredients":[{"name":"avocado","quantity":"1","unit":"whole"},{"name":"tomato","quantity":"1","unit":"whole"},{"name":"onion","quantity":"1/4","unit":"whole"},{"name":"lime","quantity":"1","unit":"whole"}],"spices":[{"name":"garlic powder","alternatives":["onion powder","fresh garlic"]},{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt","Himalayan salt"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["In a bowl, mash the avocado until smooth using a fork.","Chop the tomato and onion, adding them to the mashed avocado.","Squeeze the juice of one lime into the bowl, mixing well.","Add a sprinkle of garlic powder and salt to enhance the flavor, mixing until combined.","Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.","Serve the dip with tortilla chips or as a topping on your favorite dishes."]}

title: Fresh Avocado and Tomato Lime Rolls
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_019","title":"Fresh Avocado and Tomato Lime Rolls","calories":"200-300","cuisine":"Thai","difficulty":"Medium","description":"Refreshing rolls filled with creamy avocado, juicy tomato, and a hint of lime, perfect for a healthy snack.","servings":1,"prep_minutes":15,"cook_minutes":15,"ingredients":[{"name":"avocado","quantity":"1","unit":"whole"},{"name":"tomato","quantity":"1","unit":"whole"},{"name":"onion","quantity":"1/4","unit":"whole"},{"name":"lime","quantity":"1","unit":"whole"},{"name":"rice paper","quantity":"2","unit":"sheets"}],"spices":[{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt","kosher salt"]},{"name":"black pepper","alternatives":["white pepper","red chili flakes"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Soak the rice paper sheets in warm water for about 10 seconds until soft and pliable; remove and lay flat on a clean surface.","Slice the avocado and tomato thinly, and finely chop the onion.","Place a few slices of avocado, tomato, and a sprinkle of onion on the lower third of each rice paper sheet.","Squeeze the juice of one lime over the filling, adding salt and pepper to taste.","Carefully fold the sides of the rice paper over the filling, then roll it tightly from the bottom to the top.","Repeat with the second sheet and remaining filling.","Serve immediately with extra lime wedges on the side for dipping."]}

title: Zesty Avocado Onion Tomato Salsa
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_020","title":"Zesty Avocado Onion Tomato Salsa","calories":"150-250","cuisine":"Thai","difficulty":"Easy","description":"A vibrant salsa made with fresh avocado, tomato, and onion, perfect as a dip or topping.","servings":1,"prep_minutes":10,"cook_minutes":15,"ingredients":[{"name":"avocado","quantity":"1","unit":"whole"},{"name":"tomato","quantity":"1","unit":"whole"},{"name":"onion","quantity":"1/4","unit":"whole"},{"name":"lime","quantity":"1","unit":"whole"}],"spices":[{"name":"cumin","alternatives":["coriander","paprika"]},{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt","table salt"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["In a medium bowl, dice the avocado into small cubes and set aside.","Chop the tomato and onion finely, and add them to the bowl with the avocado.","Squeeze the juice of one lime into the mixture, adding a pinch of salt and cumin to taste.","Gently fold the ingredients together, being careful not to mash the avocado.","Taste and adjust the seasoning if necessary.","Serve immediately as a dip with tortilla chips or as a topping for tacos."]}

title: Indian Spiced Rice Bowl
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_021","title":"Indian Spiced Rice Bowl","calories":"350-450","cuisine":"Indian","difficulty":"Medium","description":"A flavorful rice bowl infused with Indian spices, paired with scrambled eggs and sautéed onions.","servings":2,"prep_minutes":10,"cook_minutes":20,"ingredients":[{"name":"rice","quantity":"100","unit":"g"},{"name":"egg","quantity":"2","unit":"pcs"},{"name":"soy sauce","quantity":"30","unit":"ml"},{"name":"onion","quantity":"1","unit":"medium"}],"spices":[{"name":"turmeric","alternatives":["curry powder","saffron"]},{"name":"cumin","alternatives":["coriander","fennel"]},{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt","pink salt"]},{"name":"black pepper","alternatives":["white pepper","green peppercorn"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Rinse 100g of rice under cold water until the water runs clear. Drain and set aside.","In a medium saucepan, bring 200ml of water to a boil, add the rinsed rice, a pinch of salt, and reduce heat to low. Cover and simmer for 15 minutes until the rice is fluffy.","While the rice is cooking, finely chop 1 medium onion and sauté it in a non-stick skillet over medium heat with a tablespoon of oil for about 5 minutes until translucent.","Add 1/2 teaspoon of turmeric and 1/2 teaspoon of cumin to the onions. Stir and cook for another 2 minutes.","Crack 2 eggs into a bowl, whisk them lightly, and pour into the skillet with the onions, stirring gently until they scramble and are fully cooked, about 3-4 minutes.","Once the rice is ready, fluff it with a fork and add 30ml of soy sauce. Combine well.","Serve the rice topped with the scrambled egg and onion mixture, garnishing with a sprinkle of black pepper."]}

title: Soy Sauce and Egg Rice Casserole
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_022","title":"Soy Sauce and Egg Rice Casserole","calories":"300-400","cuisine":"Indian","difficulty":"Easy","description":"A comforting rice casserole baked with eggs and soy sauce for an easy and hearty meal.","servings":2,"prep_minutes":10,"cook_minutes":25,"ingredients":[{"name":"rice","quantity":"150","unit":"g"},{"name":"egg","quantity":"3","unit":"pcs"},{"name":"soy sauce","quantity":"40","unit":"ml"},{"name":"onion","quantity":"1","unit":"medium"}],"spices":[{"name":"garam masala","alternatives":["cumin","curry powder"]},{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt","kosher salt"]},{"name":"black pepper","alternatives":["white pepper","green peppercorn"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Preheat the oven to 180°C (350°F).","Cook 150g of rice according to package instructions, then set aside in a large mixing bowl.","Chop 1 medium onion finely and sauté in a skillet over medium heat with a little oil until golden brown, about 6 minutes.","In a separate bowl, whisk together 3 eggs, 40ml soy sauce, 1 teaspoon garam masala, and a pinch of salt.","Combine the sautéed onions with the rice, and mix in the egg mixture until everything is evenly coated.","Pour the rice and egg mixture into a greased baking dish. Spread it evenly and smooth the top.","Bake in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until the egg is set and the top is slightly golden.","Allow to cool for a few minutes before cutting into squares to serve."]}

title: Fried Rice with Egg and Onions
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_023","title":"Fried Rice with Egg and Onions","calories":"350-450","cuisine":"Indian","difficulty":"Medium","description":"A delightful mix of fried rice, scrambled eggs, and caramelized onions, perfect for a quick meal.","servings":2,"prep_minutes":10,"cook_minutes":15,"ingredients":[{"name":"rice","quantity":"200","unit":"g"},{"name":"egg","quantity":"2","unit":"pcs"},{"name":"soy sauce","quantity":"30","unit":"ml"},{"name":"onion","quantity":"1","unit":"medium"}],"spices":[{"name":"coriander powder","alternatives":["cumin","paprika"]},{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt","Himalayan salt"]},{"name":"black pepper","alternatives":["white pepper","red pepper flakes"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Cook 200g of rice and allow it to cool completely (preferably use day-old rice).","Thinly slice 1 medium onion and sauté in a large skillet over medium-high heat until golden brown, about 5-7 minutes.","Push the onions to one side of the skillet, crack 2 eggs into the other side, and scramble until just set, about 2 minutes.","Add the cooled rice to the skillet, mixing it with the eggs and onions, stirring well to combine.","Pour 30ml of soy sauce over the rice mixture and sprinkle with 1 teaspoon of coriander powder and a pinch of salt.","Continue to stir-fry for another 5 minutes, ensuring the rice is heated and coated evenly with soy sauce.","Serve hot, garnished with black pepper for extra flavor."]}

title: Onion Egg Rice Scramble
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_024","title":"Onion Egg Rice Scramble","calories":"300-400","cuisine":"Indian","difficulty":"Easy","description":"A quick and easy rice scramble with the richness of eggs and the sweetness of onions.","servings":2,"prep_minutes":5,"cook_minutes":10,"ingredients":[{"name":"rice","quantity":"150","unit":"g"},{"name":"egg","quantity":"2","unit":"pcs"},{"name":"soy sauce","quantity":"20","unit":"ml"},{"name":"onion","quantity":"1","unit":"medium"}],"spices":[{"name":"turmeric","alternatives":["curry powder","yellow mustard"]},{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt","kosher salt"]},{"name":"black pepper","alternatives":["white pepper","chipotle powder"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Start by cooking 150g of rice according to the package instructions, then drain and set aside.","Chop 1 medium onion finely and sauté in a frying pan over medium heat with a tablespoon of oil for about 4 minutes until softened.","Add a pinch of turmeric to the onions, stirring for another minute until fragrant.","In a bowl, scramble 2 eggs, and pour them into the pan with the onions, stirring gently until just set.","Add the cooked rice to the pan, along with 20ml of soy sauce, mixing until everything is heated through.","Season with salt and black pepper to taste, ensuring the rice is well-coated.","Serve immediately for a quick and satisfying meal."]}

title: Egg and Onion Rice Pilaf
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_025","title":"Egg and Onion Rice Pilaf","calories":"350-450","cuisine":"Indian","difficulty":"Medium","description":"A fragrant pilaf featuring eggs and onions, perfect for a nutritious meal.","servings":2,"prep_minutes":10,"cook_minutes":20,"ingredients":[{"name":"rice","quantity":"150","unit":"g"},{"name":"egg","quantity":"2","unit":"pcs"},{"name":"soy sauce","quantity":"30","unit":"ml"},{"name":"onion","quantity":"1","unit":"medium"}],"spices":[{"name":"bay leaf","alternatives":["cinnamon stick","clove"]},{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt","Himalayan salt"]},{"name":"black pepper","alternatives":["white pepper","ground ginger"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["In a pot, heat 1 tablespoon of oil over medium heat and add 1 bay leaf for flavor.","Add 150g of rice and toast in the oil for 2 minutes, stirring occasionally.","Add 300ml of water and a pinch of salt, then bring to a boil. Lower the heat, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes until the rice is cooked.","Meanwhile, finely chop 1 medium onion and sauté in a separate skillet until golden brown.","In a bowl, whisk 2 eggs and pour into the skillet with the onions, scrambling until fully cooked.","Once the rice is cooked, fluff it with a fork, and mix in the onion-egg mixture along with 30ml of soy sauce.","Serve warm, garnished with black pepper for added flavor."]}

title: Mediterranean Grilled Fish
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_026","title":"Mediterranean Grilled Fish","calories":"300-400","cuisine":"Mediterranean","difficulty":"Easy","description":"Deliciously grilled fish marinated with lemon and garlic for a fresh Mediterranean taste.","servings":2,"prep_minutes":10,"cook_minutes":15,"ingredients":[{"name":"fish","quantity":"300","unit":"g"},{"name":"lemon","quantity":"1","unit":"unit"},{"name":"olive oil","quantity":"30","unit":"ml"},{"name":"garlic","quantity":"2","unit":"cloves"}],"spices":[{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt","kosher salt"]},{"name":"black pepper","alternatives":["white pepper","red pepper flakes"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Combine 30ml of olive oil, the juice of 1 lemon, and minced 2 cloves of garlic in a bowl.","Add salt and black pepper to taste, whisking the mixture until combined.","Place 300g of fish in a shallow dish and pour the marinade over, ensuring it's well coated; marinate for at least 10 minutes.","Preheat the grill to medium-high heat (about 200°C).","Remove the fish from the marinade and place on the grill; cook for 5-7 minutes on each side or until the fish is opaque and flakes easily with a fork.","Once done, remove the fish from the grill and let it rest for a few minutes.","Serve warm with additional lemon slices on the side for garnish."]}

title: Lemon Garlic Fish Pasta
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_027","title":"Lemon Garlic Fish Pasta","calories":"300-400","cuisine":"Mediterranean","difficulty":"Medium","description":"A light and flavorful pasta dish featuring sautéed fish in a lemon garlic sauce.","servings":2,"prep_minutes":10,"cook_minutes":20,"ingredients":[{"name":"fish","quantity":"300","unit":"g"},{"name":"lemon","quantity":"1","unit":"unit"},{"name":"olive oil","quantity":"40","unit":"ml"},{"name":"garlic","quantity":"3","unit":"cloves"},{"name":"pasta","quantity":"200","unit":"g"}],"spices":[{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt","Himalayan salt"]},{"name":"red pepper flakes","alternatives":["cayenne pepper","black pepper"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Cook 200g of pasta according to package instructions in salted water until al dente, then drain and set aside.","In a large skillet, heat 40ml of olive oil over medium heat.","Add minced 3 cloves of garlic to the hot oil and sauté for about 1 minute until fragrant, being careful not to burn.","Cut 300g of fish into bite-sized pieces and add to the skillet; season with salt and red pepper flakes.","Cook for about 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the fish is fully cooked and flakes easily.","Add the cooked pasta to the skillet along with the juice of 1 lemon, and toss everything together to combine well.","Serve immediately, garnished with lemon zest and extra crushed red pepper if desired."]}

title: Garlic Lemon Fish Stew
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_028","title":"Garlic Lemon Fish Stew","calories":"300-400","cuisine":"Mediterranean","difficulty":"Medium","description":"A warming and aromatic stew with tender fish, garlic, and lemon.","servings":2,"prep_minutes":15,"cook_minutes":30,"ingredients":[{"name":"fish","quantity":"300","unit":"g"},{"name":"lemon","quantity":"1","unit":"unit"},{"name":"olive oil","quantity":"30","unit":"ml"},{"name":"garlic","quantity":"4","unit":"cloves"},{"name":"vegetable broth","quantity":"500","unit":"ml"}],"spices":[{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt","table salt"]},{"name":"black pepper","alternatives":["white pepper","cayenne pepper"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["In a pot, heat 30ml of olive oil over medium heat and add minced 4 cloves of garlic; sauté for 2 minutes until fragrant.","Pour in 500ml of vegetable broth and bring to a gentle simmer.","Cut 300g of fish into cubes and add to the pot; season with salt and black pepper.","Squeeze the juice of 1 lemon into the stew and drop the spent lemon halves into the pot for added flavor.","Simmer the stew for about 15-20 minutes, making sure the fish is cooked through and tender.","Taste and adjust seasoning, adding more salt or pepper if necessary.","Serve the stew hot, garnished with fresh herbs if available, and a slice of crusty bread on the side."]}

title: Lemon Garlic Baked Fish
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_029","title":"Lemon Garlic Baked Fish","calories":"300-400","cuisine":"Mediterranean","difficulty":"Easy","description":"Oven-baked fish infused with lemon and garlic for a healthy meal.","servings":2,"prep_minutes":10,"cook_minutes":25,"ingredients":[{"name":"fish","quantity":"300","unit":"g"},{"name":"lemon","quantity":"1","unit":"unit"},{"name":"olive oil","quantity":"30","unit":"ml"},{"name":"garlic","quantity":"3","unit":"cloves"}],"spices":[{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt","flaked salt"]},{"name":"paprika","alternatives":["smoked paprika","cayenne pepper"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Preheat your oven to 200°C (400°F).","In a small bowl, mix together 30ml of olive oil, minced 3 cloves of garlic, salt, and paprika.","Place 300g of fish in a baking dish and pour the garlic mixture over it, ensuring both sides are coated.","Slice 1 lemon and arrange the slices on top of the fish.","Bake in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until the fish flakes easily with a fork.","Check for doneness by inserting a fork into the thickest part of the fish; it should be opaque.","Serve immediately, drizzling any pan juices over the fish for added flavor."]}

title: Lemon Olive Oil Fish Salad
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_030","title":"Lemon Olive Oil Fish Salad","calories":"300-400","cuisine":"Mediterranean","difficulty":"Easy","description":"A refreshing salad featuring flaked fish with a zesty lemon and olive oil dressing.","servings":2,"prep_minutes":15,"cook_minutes":10,"ingredients":[{"name":"fish","quantity":"300","unit":"g"},{"name":"lemon","quantity":"1","unit":"unit"},{"name":"olive oil","quantity":"30","unit":"ml"},{"name":"garlic","quantity":"2","unit":"cloves"},{"name":"mixed greens","quantity":"100","unit":"g"}],"spices":[{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt","Himalayan salt"]},{"name":"black pepper","alternatives":["white pepper","red chili flakes"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["In a skillet, heat 30ml of olive oil over medium heat and add minced 2 cloves of garlic; sauté for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.","Add 300g of fish, seasoning it with salt and black pepper; cook for about 5-8 minutes, breaking it into flakes as it cooks.","While the fish is cooking, prepare a bowl with 100g of mixed greens.","Once the fish is cooked, remove from heat and cool slightly before adding it to the greens.","Squeeze the juice of 1 lemon over the mixture and toss gently to combine.","Serve the salad chilled or at room temperature, garnished with extra lemon slices if desired."]}

title: Thai Avocado Tomato Stir-Fry
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_031","title":"Thai Avocado Tomato Stir-Fry","calories":"350-400","cuisine":"Thai","difficulty":"Easy","description":"A vibrant stir-fry featuring creamy avocado and fresh tomatoes, tossed with zesty lime and spices.","servings":2,"prep_minutes":10,"cook_minutes":10,"ingredients":[{"name":"avocado","quantity":"1","unit":"whole"},{"name":"tomato","quantity":"2","unit":"medium"},{"name":"onion","quantity":"1","unit":"medium"},{"name":"lime","quantity":"1","unit":"whole"}],"spices":[{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt","kosher salt"]},{"name":"red chili flakes","alternatives":["fresh chili","cayenne pepper"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Start by slicing the onion into thin strips. Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a skillet over medium heat.","Add the sliced onion to the skillet. Sauté for about 3-4 minutes until it becomes translucent and fragrant.","While the onion is cooking, chop the tomatoes into bite-sized pieces and add them to the skillet. Cook for an additional 2 minutes until they soften.","Cut the avocado in half, remove the pit, and scoop the flesh into the skillet. Gently mix all ingredients together to avoid mashing the avocado.","Squeeze the juice of 1 lime over the mixture in the skillet and season with salt and red chili flakes to taste. Stir everything for another 2 minutes.","Remove from heat and let cool slightly. Serve warm, garnished with lime wedges for extra zest."]}

title: Spicy Avocado Tomato Rice Bowl
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_032","title":"Spicy Avocado Tomato Rice Bowl","calories":"320-370","cuisine":"Thai","difficulty":"Medium","description":"A hearty rice bowl combining spicy avocado, fresh tomatoes, and zesty lime flavors.","servings":2,"prep_minutes":15,"cook_minutes":15,"ingredients":[{"name":"avocado","quantity":"1","unit":"whole"},{"name":"tomato","quantity":"2","unit":"medium"},{"name":"onion","quantity":"1","unit":"medium"},{"name":"lime","quantity":"1","unit":"whole"},{"name":"cooked rice","quantity":"200","unit":"g"}],"spices":[{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt","table salt"]},{"name":"cumin","alternatives":["coriander","paprika"]},{"name":"cayenne pepper","alternatives":["chili powder","black pepper"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Prepare cooked rice according to package instructions. Set aside once done.","Chop the onion and sauté it in a skillet over medium heat with a teaspoon of oil for about 5 minutes until golden brown.","Dice the tomatoes and add them to the skillet, cooking for another 2-3 minutes until they start to soften.","Meanwhile, cut the avocado in half, remove the pit, scoop the flesh into a bowl, and mash it slightly with a fork.","Mix lime juice, salt, cumin, and cayenne pepper into the mashed avocado to create a spicy dressing.","In serving bowls, layer the cooked rice, tomato-onion mixture, and top with the spicy avocado spread. Drizzle with additional lime juice if desired."]}

title: Fresh Avocado and Tomato Lime Rolls
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_033","title":"Fresh Avocado and Tomato Lime Rolls","calories":"300-350","cuisine":"Thai","difficulty":"Medium","description":"Refreshing rolls filled with creamy avocado and juicy tomatoes, served with a zesty lime dip.","servings":2,"prep_minutes":15,"cook_minutes":15,"ingredients":[{"name":"avocado","quantity":"1","unit":"whole"},{"name":"tomato","quantity":"2","unit":"medium"},{"name":"onion","quantity":"1","unit":"medium"},{"name":"lime","quantity":"1","unit":"whole"},{"name":"rice paper","quantity":"4","unit":"sheets"}],"spices":[{"name":"salt","alternatives":["flaked salt","sea salt"]},{"name":"black pepper","alternatives":["white pepper","cayenne pepper"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Soak rice paper sheets one at a time in warm water for about 10 seconds until soft, then lay them on a clean surface.","Slice the onion, avocado, and tomatoes into thin strips. Place a small amount of each onto the center of the soaked rice paper.","Sprinkle with salt and black pepper for flavor, and drizzle with a little lime juice.","Fold the sides of the rice paper over the filling, then roll it up from the bottom to the top tightly.","Repeat the process for all rice paper sheets and fillings. Arrange the rolls on a platter.","For dipping, mix remaining lime juice with salt and black pepper. Serve alongside the rolls for a fresh dip."]}

title: Zesty Avocado Onion Tomato Salsa
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_034","title":"Zesty Avocado Onion Tomato Salsa","calories":"300-360","cuisine":"Thai","difficulty":"Easy","description":"A fresh and zesty salsa made with creamy avocado, diced tomatoes, and onions, perfect as a dip or topping.","servings":2,"prep_minutes":10,"cook_minutes":15,"ingredients":[{"name":"avocado","quantity":"1","unit":"whole"},{"name":"tomato","quantity":"2","unit":"medium"},{"name":"onion","quantity":"1","unit":"medium"},{"name":"lime","quantity":"1","unit":"whole"}],"spices":[{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt","Himalayan salt"]},{"name":"cilantro","alternatives":["parsley","basil"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Finely chop the onion and place it in a mixing bowl.","Dice the tomatoes and add them to the bowl, mixing well with the onions.","Cut the avocado in half, remove the pit, and scoop out the flesh into the mixing bowl.","Mash the avocado slightly with a fork, mixing it with the onion and tomato.","Squeeze the juice of 1 lime over the mixture, and add salt and chopped cilantro to taste.","Fold the mixture gently until well combined, then serve as a topping or dip with chips."]}

title: Spicy Avocado Tostada with Tomato Salsa
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_035","title":"Spicy Avocado Tostada with Tomato Salsa","calories":"350-400","cuisine":"Thai","difficulty":"Medium","description":"Crispy tostadas topped with spicy avocado and a fresh tomato salsa, delivering a burst of flavor in each bite.","servings":2,"prep_minutes":10,"cook_minutes":15,"ingredients":[{"name":"avocado","quantity":"1","unit":"whole"},{"name":"tomato","quantity":"2","unit":"medium"},{"name":"onion","quantity":"1","unit":"medium"},{"name":"lime","quantity":"1","unit":"whole"},{"name":"tostada shells","quantity":"4","unit":"pieces"}],"spices":[{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt","fleur de sel"]},{"name":"cayenne pepper","alternatives":["red chili flakes","black pepper"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Preheat the oven to 180°C (350°F). Place tostada shells on a baking sheet and bake for about 5 minutes until crispy.","While the shells are baking, dice the onion and tomatoes, and mix in a bowl.","Cut the avocado in half, remove the pit, and scoop the flesh into a bowl. Mash it with a fork, adding salt and cayenne pepper to taste.","Squeeze the juice of 1 lime into the mashed avocado for flavor and mix well.","Remove tostada shells from the oven. Spread a layer of spicy avocado on each tostada shell.","Top each with the tomato-onion mixture. Serve immediately with lime wedges on the side."]}

title: Savory Sweet Potato Stew
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_036","title":"Savory Sweet Potato Stew","calories":"350-400","cuisine":"Turkish","difficulty":"Medium","description":"A hearty and comforting stew featuring sweet potatoes, onions, and garlic, perfect for a warm meal.","servings":2,"prep_minutes":15,"cook_minutes":25,"ingredients":[{"name":"sweet potato","quantity":"400","unit":"g"},{"name":"onion","quantity":"100","unit":"g"},{"name":"garlic","quantity":"4","unit":"cloves"},{"name":"butter","quantity":"30","unit":"g"}],"spices":[{"name":"cumin","alternatives":["coriander","smoked paprika"]},{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt","kosher salt"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Peel and chop the sweet potato into 1-inch cubes, and dice the onion and garlic finely.","In a pot, melt 30g of butter over medium heat. Once melted, add the diced onion and cook for about 5 minutes until translucent.","Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes until fragrant, stirring often to prevent burning.","Stir in the sweet potato cubes and add 1 teaspoon of cumin and 1 teaspoon of salt. Mix well to coat the sweet potatoes with the spices.","Pour in enough water to cover the sweet potatoes, bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 15 minutes or until the sweet potatoes are tender.","Taste and adjust seasoning if necessary, then serve hot in bowls."]}

title: Garlic Butter Sweet Potato Mash
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_037","title":"Garlic Butter Sweet Potato Mash","calories":"320-370","cuisine":"Turkish","difficulty":"Easy","description":"Creamy mashed sweet potatoes infused with garlic and butter, a perfect side dish for any meal.","servings":2,"prep_minutes":10,"cook_minutes":20,"ingredients":[{"name":"sweet potato","quantity":"500","unit":"g"},{"name":"butter","quantity":"40","unit":"g"},{"name":"garlic","quantity":"3","unit":"cloves"},{"name":"onion","quantity":"50","unit":"g"}],"spices":[{"name":"black pepper","alternatives":["white pepper","cayenne pepper"]},{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt","table salt"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Peel and chop the sweet potatoes into chunks and place them in a pot of boiling salted water. Cook for 15-18 minutes until tender.","While sweet potatoes are cooking, finely chop the onion and mince the garlic.","In a small pan, melt 40g of butter over medium heat. Add the onion and sauté for 5 minutes, then add the minced garlic and continue sautéing for an additional 2 minutes.","Drain the cooked sweet potatoes and return them to the pot over low heat.","Add the garlic butter mixture to the sweet potatoes, along with salt and black pepper to taste. Mash until smooth and creamy.","Serve warm as a delicious side dish."]}

title: Crispy Sweet Potato Fritters
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_038","title":"Crispy Sweet Potato Fritters","calories":"300-350","cuisine":"Turkish","difficulty":"Medium","description":"Crunchy on the outside and soft on the inside, these sweet potato fritters are packed with flavor.","servings":2,"prep_minutes":15,"cook_minutes":15,"ingredients":[{"name":"sweet potato","quantity":"300","unit":"g"},{"name":"onion","quantity":"50","unit":"g"},{"name":"garlic","quantity":"2","unit":"cloves"},{"name":"butter","quantity":"20","unit":"g"}],"spices":[{"name":"cumin","alternatives":["coriander","turmeric"]},{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt","Himalayan salt"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Grate the sweet potato and onion into a bowl, and mince the garlic.","Add 1 teaspoon of cumin and 1 teaspoon of salt to the grated vegetables and mix well.","Heat a frying pan over medium heat and add 20g of butter until melted.","Form the sweet potato mixture into small patties and place them in the pan, frying for 3-4 minutes on each side until golden brown.","Remove fritters from the pan and place on paper towels to absorb excess oil.","Serve warm, garnished with yogurt or a salad."]}

title: Sweet Potato and Onion Bake
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_039","title":"Sweet Potato and Onion Bake","calories":"330-380","cuisine":"Turkish","difficulty":"Hard","description":"A baked dish with layers of sweet potatoes and caramelized onions, bringing a wonderful sweetness to your meal.","servings":2,"prep_minutes":20,"cook_minutes":40,"ingredients":[{"name":"sweet potato","quantity":"400","unit":"g"},{"name":"onion","quantity":"150","unit":"g"},{"name":"garlic","quantity":"3","unit":"cloves"},{"name":"butter","quantity":"30","unit":"g"}],"spices":[{"name":"thyme","alternatives":["oregano","rosemary"]},{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt","rock salt"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Preheat your oven to 200°C (400°F).","Peel and slice the sweet potatoes into thin rounds. Thinly slice the onion and mince the garlic.","In a pan, melt 30g of butter and add the onions. Sauté for 10 minutes until softened and slightly caramelized.","In a baking dish, layer half of the sweet potato slices at the bottom, followed by half of the sautéed onions and garlic, then repeat the layers.","Sprinkle 1 teaspoon of thyme and 1 teaspoon of salt over the top layer and dot with a few bits of butter.","Cover the dish with foil and bake for 30 minutes. Remove the foil and bake for an additional 10 minutes until the top is golden and crispy."]}

title: Stuffed Sweet Potato with Garlic and Onion
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_040","title":"Stuffed Sweet Potato with Garlic and Onion","calories":"360-410","cuisine":"Turkish","difficulty":"Medium","description":"Delicious baked sweet potatoes filled with a savory mixture of sautéed onions and garlic, perfect for a nutritious meal.","servings":2,"prep_minutes":15,"cook_minutes":35,"ingredients":[{"name":"sweet potato","quantity":"500","unit":"g"},{"name":"onion","quantity":"100","unit":"g"},{"name":"garlic","quantity":"3","unit":"cloves"},{"name":"butter","quantity":"20","unit":"g"}],"spices":[{"name":"smoked paprika","alternatives":["paprika","cayenne pepper"]},{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt","iodized salt"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Preheat the oven to 200°C (400°F).","Wash and pierce the sweet potatoes with a fork, then bake for about 25-30 minutes until tender.","While the potatoes are baking, chop the onion and mince the garlic.","In a skillet, melt 20g of butter over medium heat. Add the onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes, before adding the minced garlic for another 1-2 minutes.","Once the sweet potatoes are done, carefully split them open and fluff the insides with a fork.","Spoon in the sautéed garlic and onion mixture, adding a sprinkle of smoked paprika and salt before serving."]}

title: Mediterranean Grilled Lemon Garlic Fish
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_041","title":"Mediterranean Grilled Lemon Garlic Fish","calories":"300-400","cuisine":"Italian","difficulty":"Medium","description":"A delightful grilled fish dish infused with zesty lemon and aromatic garlic, perfect for a summer meal.","servings":3,"prep_minutes":10,"cook_minutes":15,"ingredients":[{"name":"fish","quantity":"450","unit":"g"},{"name":"lemon","quantity":"2","unit":"whole"},{"name":"olive oil","quantity":"60","unit":"ml"},{"name":"garlic","quantity":"6","unit":"cloves"}],"spices":[{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt","kosher salt"]},{"name":"black pepper","alternatives":["white pepper","cracked pepper"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Start by marinating the fish in a mixture of juice from 1 lemon, 40ml of olive oil, minced garlic, salt, and black pepper. Allow it to marinate for at least 15 minutes.","Preheat a grill or a grill pan over medium-high heat for about 5 minutes until hot.","While the grill is heating, slice the remaining lemon into thin rounds.","Once the grill is ready, place the marinated fish on it. Grill for about 5-6 minutes on each side, or until the fish flakes easily with a fork.","During the last minute of grilling, place the lemon slices on the grill to caramelize, about 1-2 minutes.","Remove the fish and grilled lemon slices from the grill. Drizzle the remaining 20ml of olive oil over the fish before serving."]}

title: Lemon Garlic Baked Fish with Olive Oil Drizzle
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_042","title":"Lemon Garlic Baked Fish with Olive Oil Drizzle","calories":"300-400","cuisine":"Italian","difficulty":"Easy","description":"A simple and flavorful baked fish recipe highlighting lemon and garlic, creating a moist and juicy dish.","servings":3,"prep_minutes":10,"cook_minutes":25,"ingredients":[{"name":"fish","quantity":"450","unit":"g"},{"name":"lemon","quantity":"2","unit":"whole"},{"name":"olive oil","quantity":"45","unit":"ml"},{"name":"garlic","quantity":"4","unit":"cloves"}],"spices":[{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt","Himalayan salt"]},{"name":"black pepper","alternatives":["white pepper","fresh peppercorn"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Preheat your oven to 200°C (400°F).","In a small bowl, mix 30ml of olive oil, minced garlic, salt, and black pepper to create a marinade.","Place the fish in a baking dish and brush the marinade over it, making sure to coat it well.","Slice one of the lemons into thin rounds and place them atop the fish.","Squeeze juice from the remaining lemon over the fish, then drizzle with the remaining 15ml of olive oil.","Bake the fish in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until the fish is opaque and flakes easily with a fork.","Serve hot, garnished with the lemon rounds."]}

title: Garlic and Lemon Fish Stir-Fry
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_043","title":"Garlic and Lemon Fish Stir-Fry","calories":"300-400","cuisine":"Italian","difficulty":"Medium","description":"A quick and vibrant stir-fry dish with fish, brightened by the freshness of lemon and garlic.","servings":3,"prep_minutes":10,"cook_minutes":15,"ingredients":[{"name":"fish","quantity":"450","unit":"g"},{"name":"lemon","quantity":"1","unit":"whole"},{"name":"olive oil","quantity":"45","unit":"ml"},{"name":"garlic","quantity":"5","unit":"cloves"}],"spices":[{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt","table salt"]},{"name":"black pepper","alternatives":["white pepper","Tellicherry pepper"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Thinly slice the fish into bite-sized pieces and season with salt and black pepper.","Heat a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat and add 30ml of olive oil.","Once hot, add minced garlic. Stir-fry for about 30 seconds until fragrant, being careful not to burn.","Add the sliced fish and stir-fry for about 5-6 minutes until it turns opaque and is cooked through.","Zest the lemon and add zest along with its juice to the pan, tossing the fish to coat.","Continue to stir-fry for an additional 1-2 minutes, allowing the flavors to meld.","Serve the dish immediately with a sprinkle of extra black pepper."]}

title: Lemon Garlic Fish Salad with Olive Oil Dressing
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_044","title":"Lemon Garlic Fish Salad with Olive Oil Dressing","calories":"300-400","cuisine":"Italian","difficulty":"Easy","description":"A refreshing salad featuring fish, brightened with lemon and garlic, dressed with olive oil.","servings":3,"prep_minutes":15,"cook_minutes":15,"ingredients":[{"name":"fish","quantity":"450","unit":"g"},{"name":"lemon","quantity":"1","unit":"whole"},{"name":"olive oil","quantity":"60","unit":"ml"},{"name":"garlic","quantity":"2","unit":"cloves"}],"spices":[{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt","smoked salt"]},{"name":"black pepper","alternatives":["white pepper","lime pepper"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Poach the fish in a pot of simmering water for 8-10 minutes, or until it’s fully cooked and flakes easily.","Remove the fish from the water and let it cool slightly before flaking it into chunks.","In a small bowl, whisk together the olive oil, minced garlic, juice from the lemon, salt, and black pepper to make the dressing.","In a large bowl, combine the flaked fish with your choice of salad greens (not included in the ingredients).","Drizzle the dressing over the salad and toss gently to combine, ensuring the fish is well-coated.","Serve immediately as a light lunch or dinner option."]}

title: Zesty Lemon Garlic Fish Tacos
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_045","title":"Zesty Lemon Garlic Fish Tacos","calories":"300-400","cuisine":"Italian","difficulty":"Medium","description":"Delicious fish tacos with a zesty lemon-garlic flavor, perfect for a fun meal.","servings":3,"prep_minutes":15,"cook_minutes":10,"ingredients":[{"name":"fish","quantity":"450","unit":"g"},{"name":"lemon","quantity":"2","unit":"whole"},{"name":"olive oil","quantity":"50","unit":"ml"},{"name":"garlic","quantity":"3","unit":"cloves"}],"spices":[{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt","herbed salt"]},{"name":"black pepper","alternatives":["white pepper","Cayenne pepper"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Season the fish with salt and black pepper, and cut it into strips.","Heat 30ml of olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add minced garlic and sauté for about 1 minute until fragrant.","Add the fish strips to the skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes on each side until golden and cooked through.","In a small bowl, mix the juice of 1 lemon with the remaining olive oil and a pinch of salt.","Warm tortillas (not included in the ingredients) in a dry pan for about 30 seconds each side.","Assemble the tacos by placing the cooked fish on the tortillas, drizzling lemon-oil dressing, and spritzing with more lemon juice.","Serve with additional lime wedges on the side."]}

title: Zesty Avocado Tomato Salsa
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_046","title":"Zesty Avocado Tomato Salsa","calories":"300-400","cuisine":"Mexican","difficulty":"Easy","description":"A refreshing and zesty salsa that combines creamy avocado with ripe tomatoes and tangy lime, perfect for chips or as a topping.","servings":3,"prep_minutes":10,"cook_minutes":15,"ingredients":[{"name":"avocado","quantity":"2","unit":""},{"name":"tomato","quantity":"3","unit":""},{"name":"onion","quantity":"1","unit":""},{"name":"lime","quantity":"1","unit":""}],"spices":[{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt","kosher salt"]},{"name":"cumin","alternatives":["coriander","paprika"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Cut 2 ripe avocados in half, remove the pit, and scoop the flesh into a mixing bowl.","Dice 3 medium tomatoes and add them to the bowl with the avocado.","Finely chop 1 small onion and mix it into the avocado-tomato mixture.","Juice 1 lime, checking for seeds, and pour the lime juice over the mixture to prevent browning.","Sprinkle with 1 teaspoon of salt and 1/2 teaspoon of cumin for added flavor.","Gently stir the mixture until well combined, being careful not to mash the avocados too much.","Taste and adjust seasoning if necessary, adding more lime juice or salt as desired.","Serve immediately with tortilla chips or as a topping on tacos."]}

title: Fresh Avocado Tomato Cucumber Salad
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_047","title":"Fresh Avocado Tomato Cucumber Salad","calories":"300-400","cuisine":"Mediterranean","difficulty":"Easy","description":"A light and refreshing salad that brings together creamy avocado, juicy tomatoes, and crisp cucumber, all dressed in a tangy lime vinaigrette.","servings":3,"prep_minutes":15,"cook_minutes":15,"ingredients":[{"name":"avocado","quantity":"2","unit":""},{"name":"tomato","quantity":"3","unit":""},{"name":"onion","quantity":"1","unit":""},{"name":"lime","quantity":"1","unit":""},{"name":"cucumber","quantity":"1","unit":""}],"spices":[{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt","Himalayan salt"]},{"name":"black pepper","alternatives":["white pepper","paprika"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Peel and dice 1 cucumber, then place it in a large salad bowl.","Cut 3 medium tomatoes into wedges and add them to the bowl with the cucumber.","Slice 2 ripe avocados and add the slices to the salad bowl.","Finely chop 1 small onion and add it to the mix of vegetables.","In a small bowl, juice 1 lime and add 2 tablespoons of olive oil, along with 1/2 teaspoon of salt and 1/4 teaspoon of black pepper.","Whisk the lime dressing until emulsified, then pour it over the salad ingredients.","Gently toss the salad with a large spoon until everything is well coated with the dressing.","Serve fresh as a side dish or light main course."]}

title: Savory Avocado Tomato Onion Couscous
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_048","title":"Savory Avocado Tomato Onion Couscous","calories":"300-400","cuisine":"Middle Eastern","difficulty":"Medium","description":"A flavorful couscous dish with fresh avocado, tomatoes, and onions, complemented by a zesty lime dressing.","servings":3,"prep_minutes":10,"cook_minutes":15,"ingredients":[{"name":"couscous","quantity":"180","unit":"g"},{"name":"avocado","quantity":"2","unit":""},{"name":"tomato","quantity":"3","unit":""},{"name":"onion","quantity":"1","unit":""},{"name":"lime","quantity":"1","unit":""}],"spices":[{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt","table salt"]},{"name":"cumin","alternatives":["coriander","turmeric"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["In a saucepan, bring 450 ml of water to a boil and add 180 g of couscous.","Stir the couscous, cover the saucepan, and remove it from heat; let it sit for 5 minutes.","While the couscous is resting, chop 2 ripe avocados, 3 medium tomatoes, and 1 small onion into small pieces.","Fluff the couscous with a fork, then add the chopped vegetables to the couscous in the saucepan.","Juice 1 lime and drizzle the juice over the salad mixture, along with 1 teaspoon of salt and 1/2 teaspoon of cumin.","Gently fold the ingredients together until well mixed, being careful not to mash the avocados.","Taste and adjust seasoning if needed, adding more lime juice or spices as preferred.","Serve warm or chilled as a side dish or light lunch."]}

title: Creamy Avocado Tomato Onion Wrap
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_049","title":"Creamy Avocado Tomato Onion Wrap","calories":"300-400","cuisine":"American","difficulty":"Easy","description":"A delicious wrap filled with creamy avocado, juicy tomatoes, and crunchy onion, drizzled with lime juice for a zesty kick.","servings":3,"prep_minutes":10,"cook_minutes":15,"ingredients":[{"name":"tortilla wraps","quantity":"3","unit":""},{"name":"avocado","quantity":"2","unit":""},{"name":"tomato","quantity":"3","unit":""},{"name":"onion","quantity":"1","unit":""},{"name":"lime","quantity":"1","unit":""}],"spices":[{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt","flaky salt"]},{"name":"black pepper","alternatives":["white pepper","cayenne pepper"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Start by slicing 2 ripe avocados in half, removing the pit, and scooping the flesh into a bowl.","Mash the avocado with a fork until smooth and season with 1/2 teaspoon of salt and 1/4 teaspoon of black pepper.","Lay out 3 tortilla wraps flat on a clean surface.","Spread the mashed avocado evenly on each tortilla, covering about 3/4 of the surface.","Chop 3 medium tomatoes and 1 small onion; sprinkle them over the avocado spread on each wrap.","Juice 1 lime and drizzle the juice over the filled tortillas for added flavor.","Roll the wraps tightly from the edge nearest you, tucking in the sides as you go to secure the filling.","Cut each wrap in half and serve immediately, or wrap in foil for a packed lunch."]}

title: Creamy Avocado Tomato Onion Dip
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_050","title":"Creamy Avocado Tomato Onion Dip","calories":"300-400","cuisine":"Tex-Mex","difficulty":"Easy","description":"A creamy and tangy dip made from fresh avocados, tomatoes, and onions, perfect for snacking or as an appetizer.","servings":3,"prep_minutes":10,"cook_minutes":15,"ingredients":[{"name":"avocado","quantity":"2","unit":""},{"name":"tomato","quantity":"3","unit":""},{"name":"onion","quantity":"1","unit":""},{"name":"lime","quantity":"1","unit":""}],"spices":[{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt","kosher salt"]},{"name":"cumin","alternatives":["chili powder","paprika"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Peel and pit 2 ripe avocados, placing the flesh into a mixing bowl.","Finely chop 3 medium tomatoes and add them to the avocados in the bowl.","Dice 1 small onion and mix it into the bowl with the tomato and avocado.","Squeeze the juice of 1 lime into the bowl, taking care to avoid seeds, to enhance flavor.","Add 1/2 teaspoon of salt and 1/2 teaspoon of cumin for seasoning.","Mash the mixture with a fork until you reach your desired level of creaminess, leaving some chunks for texture.","Taste the dip and adjust the seasoning, adding more lime juice or salt if necessary.","Serve with tortilla chips, pita bread, or fresh veggies as a delicious appetizer."]}

title: Sweet Potato Hummus
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_051","title":"Sweet Potato Hummus","calories":"300-400","cuisine":"Middle Eastern","difficulty":"Easy","description":"A creamy and delicious twist on traditional hummus made with sweet potatoes, perfect for dipping or spreading.","servings":3,"prep_minutes":10,"cook_minutes":30,"ingredients":[{"name":"sweet potato","quantity":"450","unit":"g"},{"name":"onion","quantity":"150","unit":"g"},{"name":"garlic","quantity":"6","unit":"cloves"},{"name":"butter","quantity":"30","unit":"g"}],"spices":[{"name":"cumin","alternatives":["coriander","paprika"]},{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt","pink salt"]},{"name":"black pepper","alternatives":["white pepper","red pepper flakes"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Preheat the oven to 200°C (400°F).","Peel and cut the sweet potato into cubes (about 1-inch pieces), place them on a baking tray, and drizzle with 1 tablespoon of melted butter, and sprinkle with salt and black pepper.","Roast the sweet potato in the preheated oven for 25 minutes or until tender and slightly caramelized, turning halfway through for even cooking.","While the sweet potato is roasting, finely chop the onion and garlic.","In a skillet, melt the remaining butter over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and garlic, sautéing for about 5-7 minutes until they are soft and translucent.","Once the sweet potatoes are done, let them cool for a few minutes, then combine them in a food processor with the sautéed onion and garlic, cumin, and an extra pinch of salt and pepper.","Blend until smooth. If the mixture is too thick, add a tablespoon of water or olive oil to reach your desired consistency.","Serve the sweet potato hummus warm or at room temperature, garnished with a drizzle of olive oil and a sprinkle of cumin."]}

title: Sweet Potato Onion Curry
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_052","title":"Sweet Potato Onion Curry","calories":"300-400","cuisine":"Middle Eastern","difficulty":"Medium","description":"A rich and flavorful curry that combines sweet potatoes and caramelized onions, perfect served with rice or bread.","servings":3,"prep_minutes":15,"cook_minutes":25,"ingredients":[{"name":"sweet potato","quantity":"450","unit":"g"},{"name":"onion","quantity":"150","unit":"g"},{"name":"garlic","quantity":"5","unit":"cloves"},{"name":"butter","quantity":"30","unit":"g"}],"spices":[{"name":"curry powder","alternatives":["garam masala","cumin"]},{"name":"turmeric","alternatives":["saffron","coriander"]},{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt","Himalayan salt"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Peel and cube the sweet potatoes into 1-inch pieces. Finely chop the onion and garlic.","In a large pot, melt the butter over medium heat. Add the chopped onions and sauté until they are golden brown, about 10 minutes.","Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 2 minutes until fragrant, stirring frequently to prevent burning.","Sprinkle in the curry powder and turmeric, stirring well to coat the onions and garlic in the spices. Cook for another minute.","Add the cubed sweet potatoes to the pot, followed by 250ml of water. Stir to combine and bring to a simmer.","Cover the pot and cook for 15 minutes until the sweet potatoes are tender, stirring occasionally and adding more water if necessary.","Once the sweet potatoes are cooked, season with salt to taste and stir. Remove from heat.","Serve the curry hot with rice or crusty bread, garnished with fresh herbs if desired."]}

title: Garlic Butter Sweet Potato Stacks
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_053","title":"Garlic Butter Sweet Potato Stacks","calories":"300-400","cuisine":"Middle Eastern","difficulty":"Medium","description":"Layered sweet potato slices brushed with garlic butter, baked to perfection, and served as a stunning side dish.","servings":3,"prep_minutes":10,"cook_minutes":30,"ingredients":[{"name":"sweet potato","quantity":"450","unit":"g"},{"name":"onion","quantity":"150","unit":"g"},{"name":"garlic","quantity":"4","unit":"cloves"},{"name":"butter","quantity":"40","unit":"g"}],"spices":[{"name":"thyme","alternatives":["rosemary","oregano"]},{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt","kosher salt"]},{"name":"black pepper","alternatives":["white pepper","smoked paprika"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Preheat the oven to 190°C (375°F) and grease a baking dish with butter.","Peel the sweet potatoes and slice them thinly (about 1/8-inch), using a mandoline if you have one for uniform thickness.","In a small saucepan, melt the butter over low heat, then add minced garlic and cook for about 1-2 minutes until fragrant but not browned.","Layer the sweet potato slices in the greased baking dish, brushing each layer with garlic butter and sprinkling salt, pepper, and thyme between layers.","Thinly slice the onion and scatter it evenly atop the layered sweet potatoes.","Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 20 minutes. Remove the foil and bake for another 10 minutes until the sweet potatoes are tender and the top is golden.","Remove from the oven and let it cool slightly before serving. Cut into stacks and serve warm.","Garnish with additional thyme if desired for a fresh touch."]}

title: Sweet Potato Onion Hash
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_054","title":"Sweet Potato Onion Hash","calories":"300-400","cuisine":"Middle Eastern","difficulty":"Easy","description":"A hearty and savory hash made with sweet potatoes and onions, ideal for breakfast or as a side dish.","servings":3,"prep_minutes":10,"cook_minutes":20,"ingredients":[{"name":"sweet potato","quantity":"450","unit":"g"},{"name":"onion","quantity":"150","unit":"g"},{"name":"garlic","quantity":"3","unit":"cloves"},{"name":"butter","quantity":"30","unit":"g"}],"spices":[{"name":"paprika","alternatives":["smoked paprika","cayenne"]},{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt","Himalayan salt"]},{"name":"black pepper","alternatives":["white pepper","cracked black pepper"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Begin by peeling and dicing the sweet potatoes into small cubes, roughly 1/2-inch.","Chop the onion and mince the garlic cloves.","In a large skillet, melt the butter over medium heat. Once melted, add the diced sweet potato and spread it evenly in the skillet.","Cook the sweet potatoes for about 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until they start to soften and slightly brown.","Add the chopped onion and minced garlic to the skillet, stirring to combine. Cook for another 5-7 minutes until the onion becomes translucent and sweet potatoes are tender.","Sprinkle in paprika, salt, and black pepper, and mix well to ensure even seasoning.","Continue to cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, allowing the flavors to meld, and adjusting the seasoning if necessary.","Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired, as a delightful side or breakfast dish."]}

title: Sweet Potato Garlic Butter Soup
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_055","title":"Sweet Potato Garlic Butter Soup","calories":"300-400","cuisine":"Middle Eastern","difficulty":"Medium","description":"A creamy and comforting soup featuring sweet potatoes and garlic, perfect for a cozy meal.","servings":3,"prep_minutes":10,"cook_minutes":30,"ingredients":[{"name":"sweet potato","quantity":"450","unit":"g"},{"name":"onion","quantity":"150","unit":"g"},{"name":"garlic","quantity":"4","unit":"cloves"},{"name":"butter","quantity":"40","unit":"g"}],"spices":[{"name":"cinnamon","alternatives":["nutmeg","cardamom"]},{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt","Kosher salt"]},{"name":"black pepper","alternatives":["white pepper","ground pepper"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Begin by peeling and chopping the sweet potatoes into small cubes, and finely chop the onion and garlic.","In a large pot, melt the butter over medium heat. Once melted, add the chopped onion and cook for about 5 minutes until soft and translucent.","Add the minced garlic to the pot and sauté for an additional 2 minutes until fragrant.","Add the sweet potato cubes and stir to combine, cooking for about 2-3 minutes.","Pour in enough water or vegetable broth to cover the sweet potatoes (about 500ml) and add salt and pepper to taste. Bring to a boil.","Once boiling, lower the heat, cover, and simmer for 15-20 minutes until the sweet potatoes are fork-tender.","Using an immersion blender or carefully transferring to a standing blender, puree the soup until smooth and creamy. If it’s too thick, add a bit more water or broth.","Season with cinnamon, adjust salt and pepper if needed, and serve hot, garnished with a swirl of cream or a sprinkle of herbs, if desired."]}

title: Thai Chicken and Rice Stir-Fry
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_056","title":"Thai Chicken and Rice Stir-Fry","calories":"350-450","cuisine":"Thai","difficulty":"Medium","description":"A quick and flavorful one-pan dish that combines juicy chicken with rice and a medley of garlic and onions, delivering a taste of Thai cuisine.","servings":3,"prep_minutes":10,"cook_minutes":15,"ingredients":[{"name":"chicken","quantity":"450","unit":"g"},{"name":"rice","quantity":"225","unit":"g"},{"name":"onion","quantity":"1","unit":"large"},{"name":"garlic","quantity":"4","unit":"cloves"}],"spices":[{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt","table salt"]},{"name":"black pepper","alternatives":["white pepper","cayenne pepper"]},{"name":"soy sauce","alternatives":["tamari","coconut aminos"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Begin by cooking the rice: in a medium pot, combine 225g of rice with 450ml of water and 1/2 teaspoon of salt. Bring it to a boil over high heat, then reduce to low, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes until fluffy.","While the rice cooks, prep your ingredients: thinly slice 1 large onion and mince 4 cloves of garlic.","In a large skillet or wok, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium-high heat.
