Add the sliced onion and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes until they become translucent.","Next, add the minced garlic to the skillet and stir-fry for an additional 30 seconds until fragrant.","Cut 450g of chicken into bite-sized pieces and add to the skillet. Cook for 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the chicken is golden brown and cooked through.","Once the chicken is cooked, add 3 tablespoons of soy sauce and season with freshly ground black pepper to taste. Stir everything together so that the chicken is well-coated.","Finally, fold in the cooked rice, mixing well so that all ingredients are combined. Cook for an additional 2 minutes to heat through, then serve immediately."]}

title: Garlic and Onion Chicken Rice Bake
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_057","title":"Garlic and Onion Chicken Rice Bake","calories":"400-500","cuisine":"Thai","difficulty":"Medium","description":"A comforting baked dish with succulent chicken, aromatic garlic, and sweet onions over a bed of rice.","servings":3,"prep_minutes":15,"cook_minutes":30,"ingredients":[{"name":"chicken","quantity":"450","unit":"g"},{"name":"rice","quantity":"225","unit":"g"},{"name":"onion","quantity":"1","unit":"large"},{"name":"garlic","quantity":"5","unit":"cloves"}],"spices":[{"name":"salt","alternatives":["rock salt","sea salt"]},{"name":"black pepper","alternatives":["ground pepper","red pepper flakes"]},{"name":"ginger","alternatives":["ground ginger","fresh ginger"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Preheat your oven to 180°C (350°F).","In a bowl, combine 450g of cubed chicken with 2 minced cloves of garlic, 1 teaspoon of salt, 1/2 teaspoon of black pepper, and 1 teaspoon of grated ginger. Mix thoroughly and set aside to marinate while preparing other ingredients.","Thinly slice 1 large onion and set it aside. In a 9x13 inch baking dish, add 225g of uncooked rice and spread it evenly.","In a separate pot, bring 450ml of water to a boil and pour it over the rice in the baking dish. Then, add the marinated chicken on top of the rice and spread the onion slices over the chicken.","Cover the baking dish tightly with aluminum foil and bake in the preheated oven for 25 minutes.","After 25 minutes, carefully remove the foil and check for doneness. If the chicken is cooked through and the rice is tender, it is ready. If not, return it to the oven for an additional 5-10 minutes.","Let the dish sit for 5 minutes before serving, garnished with fresh herbs if desired."]}

title: Spicy Garlic Chicken with Rice
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_058","title":"Spicy Garlic Chicken with Rice","calories":"350-450","cuisine":"Thai","difficulty":"Medium","description":"A spicy and flavorful chicken dish, paired with rice, blending the heat of spices and the sweetness of garlic.","servings":3,"prep_minutes":10,"cook_minutes":20,"ingredients":[{"name":"chicken","quantity":"450","unit":"g"},{"name":"rice","quantity":"225","unit":"g"},{"name":"onion","quantity":"1","unit":"large"},{"name":"garlic","quantity":"6","unit":"cloves"}],"spices":[{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt","kosher salt"]},{"name":"black pepper","alternatives":["white pepper","Szechuan pepper"]},{"name":"chili flakes","alternatives":["cayenne pepper","paprika"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Start by preparing the rice: in a pot, combine 225g of rice with 450ml of water and 1/2 teaspoon of salt. Bring to a boil, then cover and simmer over low heat for 15 minutes until done.","While rice cooks, chop 1 large onion and mince 6 cloves of garlic.","In a large frying pan, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium-high heat. Add the onion and sauté for 3-4 minutes until soft and translucent.","Add the minced garlic to the pan and stir well, cooking for an additional minute until fragrant.","Cut 450g of chicken into bite-sized pieces, add it to the pan, and sprinkle with 1 teaspoon of chili flakes and 1/2 teaspoon of black pepper. Cook for 6-8 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through, stirring occasionally.","After the chicken is cooked, check the seasoning and adjust with salt if necessary. Cook for an additional 2 minutes to combine the flavors.","Serve the chicken mixture over the cooked rice, garnished with fresh herbs or green onions, if desired."]}

title: Onion and Garlic Chicken Rice Soup
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_059","title":"Onion and Garlic Chicken Rice Soup","calories":"300-400","cuisine":"Thai","difficulty":"Easy","description":"A warm, comforting soup that combines shredded chicken, rice, and the rich flavors of garlic and onions.","servings":3,"prep_minutes":15,"cook_minutes":30,"ingredients":[{"name":"chicken","quantity":"450","unit":"g"},{"name":"rice","quantity":"150","unit":"g"},{"name":"onion","quantity":"1","unit":"large"},{"name":"garlic","quantity":"5","unit":"cloves"}],"spices":[{"name":"salt","alternatives":["Himalayan salt","sea salt"]},{"name":"black pepper","alternatives":["white pepper","black peppercorns"]},{"name":"turmeric","alternatives":["curry powder","ginger"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Start by boiling 1.2 liters of water in a large pot. Once boiling, add 450g of whole chicken breast and cook for approximately 20 minutes until fully cooked.","Remove the chicken from the pot, let it cool slightly, and then shred it into bite-sized pieces. Set aside.","In the same pot, add 1 large chopped onion and 5 minced garlic cloves to the remaining broth. Simmer for 5 minutes until aromatic.","Next, add 150g of rice and 1 teaspoon of salt, then bring to a simmer. Cook uncovered for 15 minutes or until the rice is tender.","After 15 minutes, add the shredded chicken back into the pot along with 1/2 teaspoon of black pepper and 1/2 teaspoon of turmeric for flavor.","Continue to simmer for an additional 5 minutes, mixing occasionally to ensure the chicken and rice are heated through.","Serve hot in bowls, garnished with fresh herbs if available."]}

title: Chicken Garlic Onion Fried Rice
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_060","title":"Chicken Garlic Onion Fried Rice","calories":"380-480","cuisine":"Thai","difficulty":"Medium","description":"A delightful fried rice dish featuring tender chicken, garlic, and onion, perfect for a quick meal.","servings":3,"prep_minutes":10,"cook_minutes":15,"ingredients":[{"name":"chicken","quantity":"450","unit":"g"},{"name":"rice","quantity":"300","unit":"g"},{"name":"onion","quantity":"1","unit":"large"},{"name":"garlic","quantity":"5","unit":"cloves"}],"spices":[{"name":"salt","alternatives":["fine salt","sea salt"]},{"name":"black pepper","alternatives":["white pepper","cayenne pepper"]},{"name":"soy sauce","alternatives":["tamari","worcestershire sauce"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Begin by cooking 300g of rice according to package instructions and let it cool completely. Be careful not to burn it.","Next, add 450g of diced chicken to the pan and season with 1 teaspoon of salt and freshly ground black pepper. recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_063","title":"Savory Avocado Tomato Onion Couscous","calories":"350-400","cuisine":"Mediterranean","difficulty":"Medium","description":"This hearty couscous dish is enriched with fresh avocado, tomatoes, and onions, making a delightful side or main course.","servings":4,"prep_minutes":10,"cook_minutes":15,"ingredients":[{"name":"couscous","quantity":"200","unit":"g"},{"name":"avocado","quantity":"2","unit":"whole"},{"name":"tomato","quantity":"4","unit":"medium"},{"name":"onion","quantity":"1","unit":"medium"},{"name":"lime","quantity":"2","unit":"whole"},{"name":"vegetable broth","quantity":"400","unit":"ml"}],"spices":[{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt","pink salt"]},{"name":"black pepper","alternatives":["white pepper","green peppercorn"]},{"name":"paprika","alternatives":["smoked paprika","cayenne pepper"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["1. In a pot, bring 400 ml of vegetable broth to a boil.","2. Once boiling, add 200 g of couscous, stir, and cover the pot. Remove from heat and let it sit for 5 minutes.","3. title: Creamy Avocado Tomato Onion Wrap
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_064","title":"Creamy Avocado Tomato Onion Wrap","calories":"300-350","cuisine":"Mediterranean","difficulty":"Easy","description":"A delicious wrap filled with creamy avocado, fresh tomatoes, and onion, ideal for a quick lunch.","servings":4,"prep_minutes":10,"cook_minutes":15,"ingredients":[{"name":"tortilla wraps","quantity":"4","unit":"large"},{"name":"avocado","quantity":"2","unit":"whole"},{"name":"tomato","quantity":"4","unit":"medium"},{"name":"onion","quantity":"1","unit":"medium"},{"name":"lime","quantity":"2","unit":"whole"},{"name":"cream cheese","quantity":"200","unit":"g"}],"spices":[{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt","pink salt"]},{"name":"black pepper","alternatives":["white pepper","green peppercorn"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["1. In a mixing bowl, mash 2 avocados until smooth.","2. Spread 50 g of cream cheese evenly over each of the 4 large tortilla wraps.","3. In a separate bowl, dice 4 medium tomatoes and 1 medium onion, then add to the mashed avocado.","4. Squeeze the juice of 2 limes over the mixture and add 1 teaspoon of salt and 1/2 teaspoon of black pepper.","5. Mix the ingredients well until combined.","6. title: Creamy Avocado Tomato Onion Dip
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_065","title":"Creamy Avocado Tomato Onion Dip","calories":"250-300","cuisine":"Mediterranean","difficulty":"Easy","description":"A silky dip made from ripe avocados, fresh tomatoes, and onions, perfect for snacking with chips.","servings":4,"prep_minutes":10,"cook_minutes":15,"ingredients":[{"name":"avocado","quantity":"2","unit":"whole"},{"name":"tomato","quantity":"4","unit":"medium"},{"name":"onion","quantity":"1","unit":"medium"},{"name":"lime","quantity":"2","unit":"whole"},{"name":"sour cream","quantity":"150","unit":"g"}],"spices":[{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt","pink salt"]},{"name":"black pepper","alternatives":["white pepper","green peppercorn"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["1. In a food processor, add 2 ripe avocados, 4 medium tomatoes (diced), and 1 medium onion (chopped).","2. Add 150 g of sour cream and the juice of 2 limes to the processor.","3. Season with 1 teaspoon of salt and 1/2 teaspoon of black pepper.","4. Blend on high until the mixture is smooth and creamy, scraping down the sides as needed.","5. title: Sweet Potato Onion Hash
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_066","title":"Sweet Potato Onion Hash","calories":"350-450","cuisine":"American","difficulty":"Easy","description":"A delicious and hearty sweet potato and onion hash, perfect for breakfast or brunch.","servings":4,"prep_minutes":10,"cook_minutes":30,"ingredients":[{"name":"sweet potato","quantity":"800","unit":"g"},{"name":"onion","quantity":"200","unit":"g"},{"name":"garlic","quantity":"4","unit":"cloves"},{"name":"butter","quantity":"60","unit":"g"}],"spices":[{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt","kosher salt"]},{"name":"black pepper","alternatives":["white pepper","cayenne pepper"]},{"name":"paprika","alternatives":["smoked paprika","cayenne"]},{"name":"thyme","alternatives":["oregano","rosemary"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Peel and dice 800g of sweet potatoes into 1/2-inch cubes and set aside.","Finely chop 200g of onion and mince 4 cloves of garlic.","In a large skillet, melt 60g of butter over medium heat until foamy.","Add the chopped onion to the skillet and sauté for about 5 minutes until translucent.","Stir in the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, ensuring it doesn’t burn.","Add the diced sweet potatoes to the skillet. Season with 1 teaspoon of salt, 1/2 teaspoon of black pepper, 1 teaspoon of paprika, and 1 teaspoon of thyme. Mix everything well.","Cover the skillet, reduce heat to medium-low, and cook for about 15-20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until sweet potatoes are tender and lightly browned.","Remove from heat, adjust seasoning if necessary, and serve hot."]}

title: Garlic Butter Sweet Potato Soup
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_067","title":"Garlic Butter Sweet Potato Soup","calories":"300-400","cuisine":"American","difficulty":"Medium","description":"A comforting and creamy sweet potato soup infused with garlic and butter.","servings":4,"prep_minutes":15,"cook_minutes":25,"ingredients":[{"name":"sweet potato","quantity":"800","unit":"g"},{"name":"onion","quantity":"200","unit":"g"},{"name":"garlic","quantity":"6","unit":"cloves"},{"name":"butter","quantity":"80","unit":"g"}],"spices":[{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt","Himalayan salt"]},{"name":"black pepper","alternatives":["white pepper","red pepper flakes"]},{"name":"cumin","alternatives":["coriander","smoked paprika"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Peel and chop 800g of sweet potatoes into chunks.","Dice 200g of onion and mince 6 cloves of garlic.","In a large pot, melt 80g of butter over medium heat. Add onions and sauté for about 5 minutes until soft.","Add garlic to the pot and sauté for an additional 2 minutes until fragrant.","Add the sweet potato chunks to the pot and pour in enough water or broth to cover them. Season with 1 teaspoon of salt, 1/2 teaspoon of black pepper, and 1 teaspoon of cumin.","Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes, or until the sweet potatoes are tender.","Use an immersion blender to puree the soup until smooth, or transfer in batches to a blender. If too thick, add more broth or water.","Taste and adjust for seasoning before serving warm."]}

title: Buttery Sweet Potato Onion Roast
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_068","title":"Buttery Sweet Potato Onion Roast","calories":"350-450","cuisine":"American","difficulty":"Easy","description":"A flavorful roasted dish of sweet potatoes and onions, seasoned to perfection.","servings":4,"prep_minutes":10,"cook_minutes":30,"ingredients":[{"name":"sweet potato","quantity":"800","unit":"g"},{"name":"onion","quantity":"200","unit":"g"},{"name":"garlic","quantity":"3","unit":"cloves"},{"name":"butter","quantity":"70","unit":"g"}],"spices":[{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt","Garlic salt"]},{"name":"black pepper","alternatives":["white pepper","black peppercorns"]},{"name":"rosemary","alternatives":["thyme","sage"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Preheat your oven to 200°C (400°F).","Peel and cut 800g of sweet potatoes into wedges.","Cut 200g of onion into wedges and mince 3 cloves of garlic.","In a large mixing bowl, combine the sweet potatoes, onion, minced garlic, and 70g of melted butter. Season with 1 teaspoon of salt, 1/2 teaspoon of black pepper, and 1 teaspoon of rosemary.","Toss everything together until well coated in butter.","Spread the mixture onto a baking sheet in a single layer.","Roast in the oven for 25-30 minutes, turning halfway through, until sweet potatoes are golden and tender.","Serve warm, garnished with fresh herbs if desired."]}

title: Sweet Potato Onion Garlic Bake
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_069","title":"Sweet Potato Onion Garlic Bake","calories":"300-400","cuisine":"American","difficulty":"Medium","description":"A savory and cheesy bake featuring layers of sweet potatoes, onions, and garlic.","servings":4,"prep_minutes":15,"cook_minutes":45,"ingredients":[{"name":"sweet potato","quantity":"800","unit":"g"},{"name":"onion","quantity":"200","unit":"g"},{"name":"garlic","quantity":"5","unit":"cloves"},{"name":"butter","quantity":"50","unit":"g"}],"spices":[{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt","kosher salt"]},{"name":"black pepper","alternatives":["white pepper","smoked paprika"]},{"name":"nutmeg","alternatives":["cinnamon","allspice"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Preheat the oven to 190°C (375°F).","Peel and slice 800g of sweet potatoes thinly. Slice 200g of onion and mince 5 cloves of garlic.","In a skillet, melt 50g of butter over medium heat. Add the onions and sauté for 5-7 minutes until they're soft and translucent.","In a 9x13 inch baking dish, layer the sweet potato slices, garlic, sautéed onion, and season each layer with salt, black pepper, and a pinch of nutmeg.","Continue layering until all ingredients are used, finishing with a layer of sweet potatoes on top.","Cover the baking dish with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes.","Remove the foil and bake for an additional 15 minutes or until the top is golden and the sweet potatoes are tender.","Let it cool for a few minutes before serving."]}

title: Sweet Potato Onion Garlic Skillet
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_070","title":"Sweet Potato Onion Garlic Skillet","calories":"300-400","cuisine":"American","difficulty":"Easy","description":"A quick and delicious skillet dish with sweet potatoes, onions, and garlic.","servings":4,"prep_minutes":10,"cook_minutes":20,"ingredients":[{"name":"sweet potato","quantity":"800","unit":"g"},{"name":"onion","quantity":"200","unit":"g"},{"name":"garlic","quantity":"4","unit":"cloves"},{"name":"butter","quantity":"60","unit":"g"}],"spices":[{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt","Himalayan salt"]},{"name":"black pepper","alternatives":["white pepper","black peppercorns"]},{"name":"cumin","alternatives":["coriander","smoked paprika"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Peel and cube 800g of sweet potatoes into bite-sized pieces.","Dice 200g of onion and mince 4 cloves of garlic.","In a large skillet, melt 60g of butter over medium heat.","Add the diced onion and sauté for 3-4 minutes until it turns translucent.","Stir in the minced garlic and cook for another 1-2 minutes until fragrant.","Add the cubed sweet potatoes to the skillet, season with 1 teaspoon of salt, 1/2 teaspoon of black pepper, and 1 teaspoon of cumin. Mix well.","Cover the skillet and let cook for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until sweet potatoes are tender.","Remove the lid and cook for an additional 3-5 minutes to allow them to crisp slightly before serving."]}

title: French Chicken Risotto
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_071","title":"French Chicken Risotto","calories":"400","cuisine":"French","difficulty":"Medium","description":"A creamy chicken risotto infused with garlic and onion for an exquisite French twist.","servings":4,"prep_minutes":10,"cook_minutes":30,"ingredients":[{"name":"chicken","quantity":"600","unit":"g"},{"name":"rice","quantity":"300","unit":"g"},{"name":"onion","quantity":"2","unit":"medium"},{"name":"garlic","quantity":"4","unit":"cloves"}],"spices":[{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt","pink salt"]},{"name":"black pepper","alternatives":["white pepper","green peppercorn"]},{"name":"thyme","alternatives":["oregano","rosemary"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Finely chop the onion and garlic. Heat 2 tablespoons of olive oil in a large pan over medium heat.","Add chopped onion and sauté for 5 minutes until translucent. Add minced garlic and sauté for another 2 minutes until fragrant.","Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces. Raise heat to medium-high, add chicken pieces to the pan and cook for 7-8 minutes until browned.","Stir in the rice and cook for 2 minutes, allowing it to absorb the flavors.","Gradually add 1 liter of chicken stock, one ladle at a time, stirring constantly until the rice absorbs most of the liquid before adding more, about 20 minutes.","Once the rice is creamy and al dente, stir in 50g of butter and season with salt, pepper, and thyme. Cook for an additional 5 minutes.","Serve hot, garnished with fresh thyme leaves."]}

title: Chicken Rice Onion Stew
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_072","title":"Chicken Rice Onion Stew","calories":"350","cuisine":"French","difficulty":"Easy","description":"A hearty and comforting stew with chicken, rice, onions, and garlic.","servings":4,"prep_minutes":10,"cook_minutes":40,"ingredients":[{"name":"chicken","quantity":"600","unit":"g"},{"name":"rice","quantity":"250","unit":"g"},{"name":"onion","quantity":"2","unit":"medium"},{"name":"garlic","quantity":"4","unit":"cloves"}],"spices":[{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt","pink salt"]},{"name":"black pepper","alternatives":["white pepper","green peppercorn"]},{"name":"paprika","alternatives":["cayenne pepper","smoked paprika"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Dice the chicken into chunks and chop onions and garlic finely. In a large pot, heat 2 tablespoons of olive oil over medium heat.","Add onions and sauté for about 5 minutes until soft, then add minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.","Add the chicken to the pot and cook for about 10 minutes until browned on all sides.","Stir in the rice, followed by 1.5 liters of chicken broth. Season with salt, black pepper, and paprika.","Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce heat and let simmer, covered, for about 25 minutes, stirring occasionally to prevent sticking.","Check for doneness of rice and chicken; it should be tender and fully cooked.","Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired."]}

title: Garlic Onion Chicken Rice
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_073","title":"Garlic Onion Chicken Rice","calories":"375","cuisine":"French","difficulty":"Easy","description":"Quick and flavorful chicken rice dish with a delightful combination of garlic and onion.","servings":4,"prep_minutes":10,"cook_minutes":25,"ingredients":[{"name":"chicken","quantity":"600","unit":"g"},{"name":"rice","quantity":"400","unit":"g"},{"name":"onion","quantity":"1","unit":"large"},{"name":"garlic","quantity":"3","unit":"cloves"}],"spices":[{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt","kosher salt"]},{"name":"black pepper","alternatives":["white pepper","ground coriander"]},{"name":"basil","alternatives":["oregano","parsley"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Chop the onion and mince the garlic. Cut the chicken into small pieces.","In a large skillet, heat 2 tablespoons of olive oil over medium heat and add the onions. Sauté until softened, about 5 minutes.","Add minced garlic and cook for an additional minute until fragrant.","Increase the heat to medium-high and add the chicken pieces. title: Creamy Chicken Rice Bake
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_074","title":"Creamy Chicken Rice Bake","calories":"400","cuisine":"French","difficulty":"Medium","description":"A comforting baked dish of chicken, rice, and creamy garlic onion sauce.","servings":4,"prep_minutes":15,"cook_minutes":35,"ingredients":[{"name":"chicken","quantity":"600","unit":"g"},{"name":"rice","quantity":"300","unit":"g"},{"name":"onion","quantity":"2","unit":"medium"},{"name":"garlic","quantity":"5","unit":"cloves"}],"spices":[{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt","kosher salt"]},{"name":"black pepper","alternatives":["white pepper","crushed red pepper"]},{"name":"thyme","alternatives":["sage","bay leaf"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Preheat the oven to 180°C (350°F). Dice the chicken, chop onions, and mince garlic.","In a large bowl, combine chicken, onions, garlic, uncooked rice, and seasonings. Mix well.","Transfer the mixture into a greased baking dish. Add 900ml of chicken broth and stir to combine.","Cover the dish tightly with aluminum foil and bake for 25 minutes.","After 25 minutes, remove foil and check the liquid level. Add a splash of broth if necessary and bake uncovered for an additional 10 minutes.","Once finished baking, let it rest for 5 minutes before serving.","Serve warm with a sprinkle of fresh thyme on top."]}

title: Onion Garlic Chicken Fry
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_075","title":"Onion Garlic Chicken Fry","calories":"300","cuisine":"French","difficulty":"Easy","description":"A simple and flavorful stir-fry of chicken, enhancing the flavors of garlic and onion.","servings":4,"prep_minutes":10,"cook_minutes":20,"ingredients":[{"name":"chicken","quantity":"600","unit":"g"},{"name":"rice","quantity":"300","unit":"g"},{"name":"onion","quantity":"1","unit":"large"},{"name":"garlic","quantity":"4","unit":"cloves"}],"spices":[{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt","pink salt"]},{"name":"black pepper","alternatives":["white pepper","cracked pepper"]},{"name":"parsley","alternatives":["cilantro","dill"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Slice the chicken into strips and finely chop the onion and garlic.","In a large skillet, heat 2 tablespoons of olive oil over medium-high heat.","Add the chicken strips and season with salt and black pepper. Cook for 5-7 minutes until chicken is browned.","Add chopped onion and garlic to the skillet and sauté for another 3-5 minutes until onion is translucent and garlic is golden.","Meanwhile, cook rice according to package instructions.","Once cooked, stir the rice into the skillet with the chicken mixture, allowing the flavors to combine.","Garnish with fresh parsley before serving. Enjoy hot."]}

title: Garlic Lemon Shrimp Stir-Fry
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_076","title":"Garlic Lemon Shrimp Stir-Fry","calories":"300-400","cuisine":"Asian","difficulty":"Easy","description":"A vibrant and zesty shrimp stir-fry infused with garlic and lemon for a quick and satisfying meal.","servings":4,"prep_minutes":10,"cook_minutes":15,"ingredients":[{"name":"shrimp","quantity":"600","unit":"g"},{"name":"garlic","quantity":"6","unit":"cloves"},{"name":"butter","quantity":"60","unit":"g"},{"name":"lemon","quantity":"2","unit":"whole"}],"spices":[{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt","kosher salt"]},{"name":"black pepper","alternatives":["white pepper","cracked black pepper"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Begin by peeling and deveining the shrimp, pat them dry with a paper towel, and set aside.","Mince the garlic cloves finely and juice the lemons, reserving a few lemon slices for garnish.","In a large pan, heat the butter over medium-high heat until melted (approximately 2 minutes).","Add the minced garlic to the pan, stirring frequently, until fragrant (about 1 minute).","Increase the heat to high and add the shrimp to the pan; sauté for 4-5 minutes until they turn pink and opaque.","Pour in the lemon juice and sprinkle with salt and black pepper, cooking for an additional 1-2 minutes.","Remove from heat, garnish with lemon slices, and serve immediately over rice or noodles."]}

title: Garlic Butter Shrimp Skewers
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_077","title":"Garlic Butter Shrimp Skewers","calories":"300-400","cuisine":"Mediterranean","difficulty":"Medium","description":"Deliciously grilled shrimp skewers bathed in garlic butter and lemon, perfect for outdoor gatherings.","servings":4,"prep_minutes":15,"cook_minutes":10,"ingredients":[{"name":"shrimp","quantity":"600","unit":"g"},{"name":"garlic","quantity":"4","unit":"cloves"},{"name":"butter","quantity":"80","unit":"g"},{"name":"lemon","quantity":"2","unit":"whole"}],"spices":[{"name":"paprika","alternatives":["smoked paprika","cayenne pepper"]},{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt","herb salt"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Preheat the grill to medium-high heat (around 200°C or 400°F).","Peel and devein the shrimp, then pat them dry and place them in a bowl.","Melt the butter in a small saucepan over low heat and add minced garlic, stirring until fragrant (about 2 minutes).","Add the lemon juice and paprika to the garlic butter, mixing thoroughly.","Skewer the shrimp onto wooden or metal skewers, ensuring they are packed closely together.","Brush the garlic butter mixture over the shrimp skewers, sprinkling salt evenly.","Grill the skewers for 2-3 minutes on each side until the shrimp are pink and cooked through.","Serve hot with additional lemon wedges on the side."]}

title: Lemon Garlic Shrimp Pasta
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_078","title":"Lemon Garlic Shrimp Pasta","calories":"300-400","cuisine":"Italian","difficulty":"Easy","description":"A delightful pasta dish featuring succulent shrimp tossed in a garlic lemon sauce that embodies simplicity and flavor.","servings":4,"prep_minutes":10,"cook_minutes":15,"ingredients":[{"name":"shrimp","quantity":"600","unit":"g"},{"name":"garlic","quantity":"5","unit":"cloves"},{"name":"butter","quantity":"50","unit":"g"},{"name":"lemon","quantity":"1","unit":"whole"},{"name":"pasta","quantity":"320","unit":"g"}],"spices":[{"name":"red pepper flakes","alternatives":["cayenne pepper","chili powder"]},{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt","black salt"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Cook pasta according to package instructions in a large pot of salted boiling water until al dente (about 8-10 minutes).","Meanwhile, peel and devein the shrimp, then mince the garlic and zest the lemon.","In a large skillet, melt the butter over medium heat (approximately 2 minutes).","Add the minced garlic to the skillet, sautéing until it turns golden and fragrant (about 1-2 minutes).","Add the shrimp to the skillet and cook for 4-5 minutes until they are pink and firm.","Stir in the lemon zest, lemon juice, and red pepper flakes, cooking for an additional minute.","Drain the pasta, reserving some pasta water, and add it to the skillet. Toss everything together, adding reserved water as needed to create a sauce.","Serve hot, garnished with freshly cracked black pepper and additional lemon wedges."]}

title: Creamy Garlic Lemon Shrimp Soup
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_079","title":"Creamy Garlic Lemon Shrimp Soup","calories":"300-400","cuisine":"Fusion","difficulty":"Medium","description":"A comforting creamy soup that combines shrimp with garlic and lemon for a hearty meal with a kick of flavor.","servings":4,"prep_minutes":10,"cook_minutes":20,"ingredients":[{"name":"shrimp","quantity":"600","unit":"g"},{"name":"garlic","quantity":"5","unit":"cloves"},{"name":"butter","quantity":"70","unit":"g"},{"name":"lemon","quantity":"1","unit":"whole"},{"name":"cream","quantity":"200","unit":"ml"},{"name":"broth","quantity":"1","unit":"L"}],"spices":[{"name":"paprika","alternatives":["smoked paprika","cayenne pepper"]},{"name":"black pepper","alternatives":["white pepper","black garlic"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["In a large pot, melt the butter over medium heat (about 2 minutes).","Mince the garlic and add it to the pot, sautéing until fragrant and golden (approx. 1 minute).","Add the shrimp to the pot, cooking for 4-5 minutes until opaque and pink.","Pour in the broth and bring to a gentle simmer (about 5 minutes).","Stir in the cream and lemon juice, simmering for an additional 3-4 minutes until heated through.","Season with paprika and black pepper to taste, adjusting seasoning if necessary.","Remove from heat and let sit for a few minutes before serving.","Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley if desired."]}

title: Shrimp and Garlic Lemon Risotto
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_080","title":"Shrimp and Garlic Lemon Risotto","calories":"300-400","cuisine":"Italian","difficulty":"Medium","description":"A creamy and rich risotto infused with garlic and lemon, topped with delectable shrimp for a luxurious dish.","servings":4,"prep_minutes":10,"cook_minutes":25,"ingredients":[{"name":"shrimp","quantity":"600","unit":"g"},{"name":"garlic","quantity":"4","unit":"cloves"},{"name":"butter","quantity":"80","unit":"g"},{"name":"lemon","quantity":"1","unit":"whole"},{"name":"arborio rice","quantity":"320","unit":"g"},{"name":"broth","quantity":"1","unit":"L"}],"spices":[{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt","Himalayan salt"]},{"name":"black pepper","alternatives":["white pepper","black garlic"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["In a saucepan, heat the broth over low heat and keep it warm throughout the cooking process.","In a large pan, melt the butter over medium heat (approximately 2 minutes).","Mince the garlic and add it to the pan, sautéing until fragrant (about 1 minute).","Stir in the arborio rice, coating it in butter and garlic for 2-3 minutes until it becomes translucent.","Add one ladle of warm broth to the rice, stirring frequently until absorbed; repeat this process for about 15-18 minutes.","In the final minutes, add shrimp to the risotto along with lemon juice, cooking until the shrimp are pink.","Finish with black pepper and adjust seasoning as needed; remove from heat.","Serve immediately with extra lemon wedges for garnish."]}

title: Savory Sweet Potato Onion Bake
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_081","title":"Savory Sweet Potato Onion Bake","calories":"350-400","cuisine":"American","difficulty":"Medium","description":"A comforting baked dish combining sweet potatoes and onions with a rich buttery flavor.","servings":5,"prep_minutes":15,"cook_minutes":45,"ingredients":[{"name":"sweet potato","quantity":"1.5","unit":"kg"},{"name":"onion","quantity":"250","unit":"g"},{"name":"garlic","quantity":"10","unit":"cloves"},{"name":"butter","quantity":"100","unit":"g"}],"spices":[{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt","pink salt"]},{"name":"black pepper","alternatives":["white pepper","green peppercorn"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Preheat your oven to 200°C (400°F).","Peel and cube the sweet potatoes into 1-inch pieces and place them in a large mixing bowl.","Dice the onion and mince the garlic, then add both to the sweet potatoes.","Melt the butter in a small saucepan and pour it over the sweet potato mixture, ensuring an even coating.","Season generously with salt and black pepper, then mix well.","Transfer the mixture to a large baking dish, spreading it out evenly.","Bake in the preheated oven for 35-40 minutes, stirring halfway through, until the sweet potatoes are tender and lightly browned.","Let it cool for 5 minutes before serving."]}

title: Creamy Sweet Potato Garlic Mash
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_082","title":"Creamy Sweet Potato Garlic Mash","calories":"300-350","cuisine":"American","difficulty":"Easy","description":"A smooth and creamy mashed sweet potato dish infused with garlic and butter.","servings":5,"prep_minutes":10,"cook_minutes":25,"ingredients":[{"name":"sweet potato","quantity":"1.5","unit":"kg"},{"name":"onion","quantity":"150","unit":"g"},{"name":"garlic","quantity":"8","unit":"cloves"},{"name":"butter","quantity":"80","unit":"g"}],"spices":[{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt","kosher salt"]},{"name":"black pepper","alternatives":["white pepper","cayenne pepper"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Peel and chop the sweet potatoes into large chunks, then set them aside.","Dice the onion and mince the garlic.","In a large pot, bring water to a boil and add sweet potatoes, cooking for about 15-20 minutes until fork-tender.","In the last 5 minutes of cooking, add the minced garlic to the pot.","Drain the sweet potatoes and garlic, then return them to the pot.","Add the butter and mash everything together until smooth and creamy.","Season with salt and black pepper to taste, stirring well to combine.","Serve warm, garnished with finely chopped cooked onion."]}

title: Sweet Potato Onion Garlic Skillet
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_083","title":"Sweet Potato Onion Garlic Skillet","calories":"350-400","cuisine":"American","difficulty":"Medium","description":"A quick and delicious skillet dish showcasing sweet potatoes sautéed with onions and garlic.","servings":5,"prep_minutes":10,"cook_minutes":30,"ingredients":[{"name":"sweet potato","quantity":"1.5","unit":"kg"},{"name":"onion","quantity":"200","unit":"g"},{"name":"garlic","quantity":"6","unit":"cloves"},{"name":"butter","quantity":"90","unit":"g"}],"spices":[{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt","flaky salt"]},{"name":"paprika","alternatives":["smoked paprika","cayenne pepper"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Peel and dice the sweet potatoes into small cubes (about 1/2 inch).","Chop the onion and mince the garlic.","In a large skillet, melt butter over medium heat and add the diced sweet potatoes.","Sauté the sweet potatoes for about 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until they start to soften.","Add the chopped onion and garlic to the skillet, cooking for an additional 10-12 minutes, until the onion becomes translucent and sweet potatoes are tender.","Season the mix with salt and paprika, stirring to combine.","Continue cooking for another 5 minutes for flavor development.","Serve hot as a hearty side dish or main."]}

title: Butter Garlic Sweet Potato Stew
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_084","title":"Butter Garlic Sweet Potato Stew","calories":"400-450","cuisine":"American","difficulty":"Medium","description":"A warm and hearty sweet potato stew flavored with garlic and butter for a comforting meal.","servings":5,"prep_minutes":15,"cook_minutes":40,"ingredients":[{"name":"sweet potato","quantity":"1.5","unit":"kg"},{"name":"onion","quantity":"250","unit":"g"},{"name":"garlic","quantity":"10","unit":"cloves"},{"name":"butter","quantity":"120","unit":"g"}],"spices":[{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt","kosher salt"]},{"name":"black pepper","alternatives":["white pepper","cracked pepper"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Heat a large pot over medium heat and melt the butter until bubbly.","Chop the onion and add it to the pot, cooking until translucent (about 5-7 minutes).","Peel and cube the sweet potatoes into 1-inch pieces and add them to the pot.","Mince the garlic and stir it into the mixture.","Pour in enough water to cover the sweet potatoes and bring to a simmer.","Season with salt and black pepper; let the stew cook for 30 minutes or until the sweet potatoes are fork-tender.","Stir occasionally and adjust seasoning as needed.","Serve hot, optionally garnished with fresh herbs."]}

title: Garlic Butter Sweet Potato Fritters
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_085","title":"Garlic Butter Sweet Potato Fritters","calories":"300-350","cuisine":"American","difficulty":"Easy","description":"Crispy fritters made from sweet potatoes, onions, and garlic, perfect as a snack or side.","servings":5,"prep_minutes":15,"cook_minutes":20,"ingredients":[{"name":"sweet potato","quantity":"1.5","unit":"kg"},{"name":"onion","quantity":"150","unit":"g"},{"name":"garlic","quantity":"5","unit":"cloves"},{"name":"butter","quantity":"80","unit":"g"}],"spices":[{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt","table salt"]},{"name":"cumin","alternatives":["coriander","paprika"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Grate the sweet potatoes and place them in a large bowl.","Finely chop the onion and mince the garlic, adding both to the bowl with sweet potatoes.","Melt the butter and mix it into the sweet potato mixture, ensuring all ingredients are coated.","Season with salt and cumin, mixing well until combined.","Heat a large skillet over medium heat and grease lightly with butter.","Spoon about 1/4 cup of the mixture into the skillet for each fritter, flattening with a spatula.","Cook each fritter for 4-5 minutes on each side, until golden brown and crispy.","Drain on paper towels and serve warm."]}

title: French Garlic Chicken Rice Pilaf
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_086","title":"French Garlic Chicken Rice Pilaf","calories":"350-400","cuisine":"French","difficulty":"Medium","description":"A flavorful rice pilaf with tender chicken, aromatic garlic, and onions, infused with herbs.","servings":5,"prep_minutes":15,"cook_minutes":25,"ingredients":[{"name":"chicken","quantity":"750","unit":"g"},{"name":"rice","quantity":"500","unit":"g"},{"name":"onion","quantity":"150","unit":"g"},{"name":"garlic","quantity":"10","unit":"cloves"}],"spices":[{"name":"thyme","alternatives":["oregano","rosemary"]},{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt","kosher salt"]},{"name":"black pepper","alternatives":["white pepper","smoked paprika"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["In a large skillet, heat 3 tablespoons of olive oil over medium heat for about 2 minutes until shimmering.","Add 750g of diced chicken and cook for 8-10 minutes until browned and cooked through, stirring occasionally.","Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside. In the same skillet, add 150g of finely chopped onions and sauté for 3-4 minutes until translucent.","Add 10 minced garlic cloves and sauté for an additional 1-2 minutes until fragrant.","Stir in 500g of rinsed rice and cook for 2 minutes, allowing it to toast slightly before adding 1.25 liters of chicken broth along with thyme, salt, and black pepper to taste.","Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15-20 minutes until the rice is tender and the liquid is absorbed.","Fold the cooked chicken back into the skillet and stir gently. Allow to sit for 5 minutes covered before serving."]}

title: Herb Roasted Chicken with Garlic Rice
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_087","title":"Herb Roasted Chicken with Garlic Rice","calories":"400","cuisine":"French","difficulty":"Medium","description":"Juicy roasted chicken served over fragrant garlic-flavored rice, a perfect family meal.","servings":5,"prep_minutes":10,"cook_minutes":40,"ingredients":[{"name":"chicken","quantity":"1000","unit":"g"},{"name":"rice","quantity":"500","unit":"g"},{"name":"onion","quantity":"150","unit":"g"},{"name":"garlic","quantity":"5","unit":"cloves"}],"spices":[{"name":"rosemary","alternatives":["thyme","sage"]},{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt","pink salt"]},{"name":"black pepper","alternatives":["white pepper","cayenne pepper"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Preheat the oven to 200°C (400°F) and line a baking tray with parchment paper.","Season 1kg of chicken with salt, black pepper, and 2 teaspoons of dried rosemary, ensuring it is evenly coated.","Place the chicken on the prepared tray and roast it in the preheated oven for about 30-35 minutes until the internal temperature reaches 75°C (165°F).","While the chicken is roasting, rinse 500g of rice under cold water until the water runs clear.","In a saucepan, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium heat, add 150g of finely chopped onions and sauté for 3-4 minutes until soft.","Add 5 minced garlic cloves and cook for an additional minute, then add the rinsed rice and stir for 2 minutes to coat.","Pour in 1.25 liters of water, bring to a boil, cover, and simmer for about 15 minutes until the rice is cooked and water is absorbed.","Serve the roasted chicken over the garlic rice and drizzle with any pan juices."]}

title: One-Pan French Garlic Chicken & Rice
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_088","title":"One-Pan French Garlic Chicken & Rice","calories":"350-375","cuisine":"French","difficulty":"Easy","description":"A simple one-pan dish that brings together flavorful garlic chicken and fluffy rice.","servings":5,"prep_minutes":12,"cook_minutes":30,"ingredients":[{"name":"chicken","quantity":"750","unit":"g"},{"name":"rice","quantity":"425","unit":"g"},{"name":"onion","quantity":"100","unit":"g"},{"name":"garlic","quantity":"6","unit":"cloves"}],"spices":[{"name":"paprika","alternatives":["smoked paprika","cayenne"]},{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt","table salt"]},{"name":"black pepper","alternatives":["white pepper","cracked pepper"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["In a large skillet, heat 3 tablespoons of olive oil over medium-high heat for about 2 minutes until hot.","Season 750g of chicken thighs with salt, black pepper, and 1 tablespoon of paprika, and add them to the skillet. In the same skillet, add 100g of diced onion and sauté for about 3 minutes until slightly soft.","Add 6 minced garlic cloves to the onion and cook for another minute until fragrant.","Stir in 425g of rinsed rice and toast for 2-3 minutes, stirring constantly.","Pour in 1.25 liters of chicken broth, bring the mixture to a boil, then return the chicken to the pan.","Reduce heat to low, cover, and cook for 20 minutes until the rice is tender and chicken is cooked through. Fluff the rice before serving."]}

title: Garlic-Onion Chicken Rice Bake
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_089","title":"Garlic-Onion Chicken Rice Bake","calories":"375","cuisine":"French","difficulty":"Medium","description":"A wholesome baked dish combining chicken, onions, garlic, and rice baked to perfection.","servings":5,"prep_minutes":15,"cook_minutes":40,"ingredients":[{"name":"chicken","quantity":"750","unit":"g"},{"name":"rice","quantity":"500","unit":"g"},{"name":"onion","quantity":"150","unit":"g"},{"name":"garlic","quantity":"8","unit":"cloves"}],"spices":[{"name":"thyme","alternatives":["basil","marjoram"]},{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt","kosher salt"]},{"name":"black pepper","alternatives":["white pepper","ground pepper"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Preheat the oven to 190°C (375°F) and grease a large baking dish with cooking spray.","In a skillet, heat 2 tablespoons of olive oil over medium heat and cook 750g of chopped chicken until lightly browned, about 5-7 minutes.","Add 150g of chopped onions and 8 minced garlic cloves to the skillet and sauté for an additional 3 minutes until onions are translucent.","In a large bowl, combine 500g of rinsed rice, 1.25 liters of chicken broth, salt, black pepper, and thyme. Mix until well combined.","Transfer the chicken mixture into the bowl and stir gently to combine before pouring it into the prepared baking dish.","Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes, then uncover and bake for an additional 10 minutes until the rice is cooked and the liquid is evaporated.","Let it cool for 5 minutes before serving to enhance flavors."]}

title: Creamy Garlic Chicken and Rice Casserole
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_090","title":"Creamy Garlic Chicken and Rice Casserole","calories":"400","cuisine":"French","difficulty":"Hard","description":"A comforting creamy casserole filled with tender chicken, flavorful spices, and rice baked to perfection.","servings":5,"prep_minutes":20,"cook_minutes":35,"ingredients":[{"name":"chicken","quantity":"750","unit":"g"},{"name":"rice","quantity":"400","unit":"g"},{"name":"onion","quantity":"150","unit":"g"},{"name":"garlic","quantity":"7","unit":"cloves"}],"spices":[{"name":"parsley","alternatives":["chives","basil"]},{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt","Himalayan salt"]},{"name":"black pepper","alternatives":["white pepper","paprika"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Preheat the oven to 180°C (350°F). title: Garlic Lemon Shrimp Pasta
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_091","title":"Garlic Lemon Shrimp Pasta","calories":"300-400","cuisine":"Mediterranean","difficulty":"Medium","description":"A delicious pasta dish with succulent shrimp, aromatic garlic, and a zesty lemon sauce.","servings":5,"prep_minutes":10,"cook_minutes":20,"ingredients":[{"name":"shrimp","quantity":"750","unit":"g"},{"name":"garlic","quantity":"10","unit":"cloves"},{"name":"butter","quantity":"125","unit":"g"},{"name":"lemon","quantity":"2","unit":"whole"},{"name":"spaghetti","quantity":"500","unit":"g"}],"spices":[{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt","kosher salt"]},{"name":"black pepper","alternatives":["white pepper","crushed red pepper"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Boil a large pot of salted water. Add 500g of spaghetti and cook according to package instructions until al dente, about 8-10 minutes.","While the pasta cooks, peel and finely chop 10 cloves of garlic.","In a large skillet, melt 125g of butter over medium heat. Add the chopped garlic and sauté for 2-3 minutes until fragrant, making sure not to burn it.","Add 750g of shrimp to the skillet, season with salt and black pepper, and cook until the shrimp turn pink, about 5-6 minutes, stirring occasionally.","Zest and juice 2 whole lemons, adding both the zest and juice to the skillet. Add the drained pasta to the skillet with shrimp and garlic sauce, tossing to combine. title: Garlic Butter Shrimp Skillet
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_092","title":"Garlic Butter Shrimp Skillet","calories":"300-400","cuisine":"Mediterranean","difficulty":"Easy","description":"Quick and flavorful shrimp cooked in a rich garlic butter sauce, perfect for weeknight dinners.","servings":5,"prep_minutes":5,"cook_minutes":15,"ingredients":[{"name":"shrimp","quantity":"750","unit":"g"},{"name":"garlic","quantity":"8","unit":"cloves"},{"name":"butter","quantity":"100","unit":"g"},{"name":"lemon","quantity":"1","unit":"whole"},{"name":"parsley","quantity":"50","unit":"g"}],"spices":[{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt","table salt"]},{"name":"cayenne pepper","alternatives":["paprika","chili powder"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["In a large skillet, melt 100g of butter over medium heat.","Mince 8 cloves of garlic and add to the melted butter, cooking for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.","Add 750g of shrimp to the skillet, mixing well to coat in the garlic butter. Season with salt and cayenne pepper to taste.","Cook the shrimp for about 5-7 minutes or until they are pink and opaque, stirring occasionally.","Zest and squeeze the juice of 1 whole lemon into the skillet, mixing thoroughly.","Remove from heat and sprinkle 50g of chopped parsley over the shrimp for freshness.","Serve hot, with crusty bread for dipping into the delicious garlic butter."]}

title: Lemon Garlic Shrimp Stir-Fry
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_093","title":"Lemon Garlic Shrimp Stir-Fry","calories":"300-400","cuisine":"Mediterranean","difficulty":"Medium","description":"A vibrant stir-fry of shrimp, lemon, and garlic, served over rice for a wholesome meal.","servings":5,"prep_minutes":10,"cook_minutes":15,"ingredients":[{"name":"shrimp","quantity":"750","unit":"g"},{"name":"garlic","quantity":"6","unit":"cloves"},{"name":"butter","quantity":"100","unit":"g"},{"name":"lemon","quantity":"1","unit":"whole"},{"name":"bell pepper","quantity":"2","unit":"whole"},{"name":"broccoli","quantity":"250","unit":"g"},{"name":"rice","quantity":"300","unit":"g"}],"spices":[{"name":"salt","alternatives":["rock salt","Himalayan salt"]},{"name":"black pepper","alternatives":["white pepper","red pepper flakes"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Start by cooking 300g of rice according to package directions; once done, set aside.","In a large skillet, melt 100g of butter over medium-high heat.","Mince 6 cloves of garlic and add them to the skillet, sautéing for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.","Add 750g of shrimp to the skillet, stirring continuously for about 5 minutes until they are pink and opaque.","While shrimp is cooking, slice 2 bell peppers and chop 250g of broccoli into florets.","Add the bell peppers and broccoli to the skillet, stirring well, and season with salt and black pepper. Sauté for another 5 minutes until vegetables are tender.","Zest and juice 1 whole lemon into the skillet, mixing all the ingredients well.","Serve the stir-fry over the cooked rice, garnished with additional lemon zest if desired."]}

title: Shrimp and Garlic Lemon Risotto
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_094","title":"Shrimp and Garlic Lemon Risotto","calories":"300-400","cuisine":"Mediterranean","difficulty":"Hard","description":"Creamy risotto enriched with shrimp, garlic, and a touch of lemon, perfect for a refined dinner.","servings":5,"prep_minutes":15,"cook_minutes":30,"ingredients":[{"name":"shrimp","quantity":"750","unit":"g"},{"name":"garlic","quantity":"8","unit":"cloves"},{"name":"butter","quantity":"100","unit":"g"},{"name":"lemon","quantity":"1","unit":"whole"},{"name":"arborio rice","quantity":"500","unit":"g"},{"name":"chicken broth","quantity":"1.5","unit":"L"},{"name":"parmesan cheese","quantity":"100","unit":"g"}],"spices":[{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt","flaked salt"]},{"name":"black pepper","alternatives":["white pepper","ground black pepper"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["In a saucepan, bring 1.5L of chicken broth to simmer over medium heat.","In a large skillet, melt 100g of butter over medium heat and add minced 8 cloves of garlic, sautéing for 2 minutes until fragrant.","Add 500g of arborio rice to the skillet, stirring to coat the rice with butter and toast it for 1-2 minutes.","Begin adding the warmed chicken broth 1 ladle at a time, stirring frequently and allowing the liquid to be absorbed before adding more. This process should take about 20 minutes.","When the risotto is creamy and al dente, stir in 750g of shrimp, cooking until they turn pink, about 5 minutes.","Zest and juice 1 whole lemon into the risotto, stirring well to combine.","Remove from heat and stir in 100g grated parmesan cheese, seasoning with salt and black pepper to taste.","Serve hot, garnished with additional lemon zest and parmesan if desired."]}

title: Creamy Garlic Lemon Shrimp Soup
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_095","title":"Creamy Garlic Lemon Shrimp Soup","calories":"300-400","cuisine":"Mediterranean","difficulty":"Medium","description":"A comforting soup featuring shrimp, garlic, and lemon, perfect for a cozy evening.","servings":5,"prep_minutes":10,"cook_minutes":20,"ingredients":[{"name":"shrimp","quantity":"750","unit":"g"},{"name":"garlic","quantity":"6","unit":"cloves"},{"name":"butter","quantity":"75","unit":"g"},{"name":"lemon","quantity":"1","unit":"whole"},{"name":"chicken broth","quantity":"1","unit":"L"},{"name":"heavy cream","quantity":"250","unit":"ml"},{"name":"spinach","quantity":"200","unit":"g"}],"spices":[{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt","table salt"]},{"name":"black pepper","alternatives":["white pepper","cracked black pepper"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["In a large pot, melt 75g of butter over medium heat and add minced 6 cloves of garlic. title: Soy Sauce Fried Rice
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_096","title":"Soy Sauce Fried Rice","calories":"350-450","cuisine":"Asian","difficulty":"Easy","description":"A quick and flavorful fried rice dish with soy sauce and onion for a savory kick.","servings":5,"prep_minutes":10,"cook_minutes":15,"ingredients":[{"name":"rice","quantity":"500","unit":"g"},{"name":"egg","quantity":"5","unit":"unit"},{"name":"soy sauce","quantity":"75","unit":"ml"},{"name":"onion","quantity":"150","unit":"g"}],"spices":[{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt","Himalayan salt"]},{"name":"black pepper","alternatives":["white pepper","crushed red pepper"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Begin by cooking the rice in a rice cooker or on the stove with a water-to-rice ratio of 2:1. title: Savory Egg Rice Bowl
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_097","title":"Savory Egg Rice Bowl","calories":"300-400","cuisine":"Asian","difficulty":"Medium","description":"A comforting egg rice bowl topped with sautéed onions and a splash of soy sauce.","servings":5,"prep_minutes":12,"cook_minutes":18,"ingredients":[{"name":"rice","quantity":"500","unit":"g"},{"name":"egg","quantity":"5","unit":"unit"},{"name":"soy sauce","quantity":"50","unit":"ml"},{"name":"onion","quantity":"150","unit":"g"}],"spices":[{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt","kosher salt"]},{"name":"ginger","alternatives":["ground ginger","fresh ginger"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Cook the rice according to package instructions, then set aside to cool slightly.","Thinly slice the onion and heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a pan over medium heat. title: Onion and Egg Stir-fried Rice
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_098","title":"Onion and Egg Stir-fried Rice","calories":"350-450","cuisine":"Asian","difficulty":"Easy","description":"A playful and delightful egg stir-fried rice mixed with onions for a savory treat.","servings":5,"prep_minutes":10,"cook_minutes":15,"ingredients":[{"name":"rice","quantity":"500","unit":"g"},{"name":"egg","quantity":"5","unit":"unit"},{"name":"soy sauce","quantity":"60","unit":"ml"},{"name":"onion","quantity":"150","unit":"g"}],"spices":[{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt","flavored salt"]},{"name":"black pepper","alternatives":["white pepper","cayenne pepper"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Prepare the rice by cooking it as per the instructions ensuring it's fluffy. recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_099","title":"Baked Egg and Onion Rice Casserole","calories":"370-480","cuisine":"Asian","difficulty":"Medium","description":"A hearty and satisfying baked rice casserole topped with eggs and onions.","servings":5,"prep_minutes":15,"cook_minutes":30,"ingredients":[{"name":"rice","quantity":"500","unit":"g"},{"name":"egg","quantity":"5","unit":"unit"},{"name":"soy sauce","quantity":"75","unit":"ml"},{"name":"onion","quantity":"150","unit":"g"}],"spices":[{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt","garlic salt"]},{"name":"black pepper","alternatives":["white pepper","black peppercorns"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Preheat your oven to 180°C (350°F). title: Vietnamese Garlic Shrimp Stir-Fry
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_106","title":"Vietnamese Garlic Shrimp Stir-Fry","calories":"300-400","cuisine":"Vietnamese","difficulty":"Medium","description":"A quick and flavorful shrimp stir-fry infused with garlic and tangy lemon, perfect for a weeknight dinner.","servings":6,"prep_minutes":10,"cook_minutes":15,"ingredients":[{"name":"shrimp","quantity":"900","unit":"g"},{"name":"garlic","quantity":"12","unit":"cloves"},{"name":"butter","quantity":"90","unit":"g"},{"name":"lemon","quantity":"3","unit":"whole"}],"spices":[{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt","Himalayan salt"]},{"name":"black pepper","alternatives":["white pepper","red pepper flakes"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Melt 90g of butter in a large skillet over medium heat, around 4 minutes.","Mince 12 cloves of garlic and add them to the skillet, stirring occasionally until fragrant, about 1-2 minutes.","Add 900g of peeled and deveined shrimp to the skillet, increase the heat to medium-high.","Cook the shrimp for 3-4 minutes, stirring continuously until they turn pink and opaque.","Squeeze the juice of 3 lemons into the skillet, and add salt and black pepper to taste.","Toss the shrimp well, cooking for an additional 1-2 minutes to combine flavors.","Serve hot with steamed rice or noodles, garnished with lemon wedges."]}

title: Lemon Garlic Butter Shrimp
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_107","title":"Lemon Garlic Butter Shrimp","calories":"300-400","cuisine":"Vietnamese","difficulty":"Easy","description":"Delightfully buttery shrimp with a zesty lemon twist, quickly made in one skillet.","servings":6,"prep_minutes":10,"cook_minutes":10,"ingredients":[{"name":"shrimp","quantity":"900","unit":"g"},{"name":"garlic","quantity":"9","unit":"cloves"},{"name":"butter","quantity":"90","unit":"g"},{"name":"lemon","quantity":"3","unit":"whole"}],"spices":[{"name":"salt","alternatives":["kosher salt","sea salt"]},{"name":"paprika","alternatives":["smoked paprika","cayenne pepper"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["In a large skillet, melt 90g of butter over medium heat for about 3 minutes.","Add 9 minced garlic cloves and sauté for 1-2 minutes until translucent and fragrant.","Add 900g of shrimp to the skillet, increasing temperature to medium-high.","Cook the shrimp for 4-5 minutes or until they are fully pink and cooked through.","Squeeze the juice of 3 lemons over the shrimp and season with salt and paprika.","Toss everything to coat well, cooking for an additional minute until combined.","Remove from heat and serve immediately with crusty bread or over rice."]}

recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_108","title":"Shrimp and Garlic Lemon Noodles","calories":"300-400","cuisine":"Vietnamese","difficulty":"Medium","description":"A vibrant dish of shrimp and noodles tossed in a lemon-garlic sauce, fresh and satisfying.","servings":6,"prep_minutes":10,"cook_minutes":15,"ingredients":[{"name":"shrimp","quantity":"900","unit":"g"},{"name":"garlic","quantity":"9","unit":"cloves"},{"name":"butter","quantity":"90","unit":"g"},{"name":"lemon","quantity":"3","unit":"whole"},{"name":"noodles","quantity":"500","unit":"g"}],"spices":[{"name":"salt","alternatives":["table salt","sea salt"]},{"name":"black pepper","alternatives":["white pepper","cayenne pepper"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Cook 500g of noodles according to package instructions, drain and set aside.","In a large skillet, melt 90g of butter on medium heat for about 3 minutes.","Mince 9 cloves of garlic and add to the butter, stirring continuously until fragrant, about 1-2 minutes.","Add 900g of shrimp to the skillet, cooking for 4-5 minutes until they are pink and opaque.","Squeeze the juice of 3 lemons over shrimp and season with salt and black pepper.","Add cooked noodles to the skillet, tossing everything to coat well in the sauce.","Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes to heat through and serve immediately."]}

title: Creamy Garlic Lemon Shrimp
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_110","title":"Creamy Garlic Lemon Shrimp","calories":"300-400","cuisine":"Vietnamese","difficulty":"Medium","description":"A luscious shrimp dish with a creamy garlic lemon sauce, great over rice or pasta.","servings":6,"prep_minutes":10,"cook_minutes":15,"ingredients":[{"name":"shrimp","quantity":"900","unit":"g"},{"name":"garlic","quantity":"10","unit":"cloves"},{"name":"butter","quantity":"90","unit":"g"},{"name":"lemon","quantity":"3","unit":"whole"},{"name":"cream","quantity":"250","unit":"ml"}],"spices":[{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt","Himalayan salt"]},{"name":"black pepper","alternatives":["white pepper","cayenne pepper"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["In a large skillet over medium heat, melt 90g of butter for about 3 minutes.","Mince 10 cloves of garlic and add to the skillet, stirring until fragrant, approximately 1-2 minutes.","Add 900g of shrimp and cook for 4-5 minutes until they turn pink.","Pour in 250ml of cream and juice of 3 lemons, stirring well to combine.","Season with salt and black pepper to taste, cooking for an additional 2-3 minutes until the sauce thickens.","Serve immediately over rice or pasta, garnished with lemon zest."]}

title: Turkish Rice and Egg Casserole
recipe_data: {"id":"cache_seed_111","title":"Turkish Rice and Egg Casserole","calories":"350-450","cuisine":"Turkish","difficulty":"Medium","description":"A hearty Turkish casserole combining rice, eggs, and aromatic spices for a delicious meal.","servings":6,"prep_minutes":15,"cook_minutes":30,"ingredients":[{"name":"rice","quantity":"600","unit":"g"},{"name":"egg","quantity":"6","unit":"pcs"},{"name":"soy sauce","quantity":"90","unit":"ml"},{"name":"onion","quantity":"300","unit":"g"}],"spices":[{"name":"black pepper","alternatives":["white pepper","crushed red pepper"]},{"name":"paprika","alternatives":["smoked paprika","cayenne pepper"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Preheat the oven to 180°C (350°F).","In a large pot, cook 600g of rice in 1.2 liters of water (double the rice amount) over medium heat until tender, about 15 minutes.","Meanwhile, chop 300g of onion finely. title: Onion and Egg Rice Kebab
